notes.zh: 插件加载新增跨进程快照缓存，绑定原始配置、状态目录、内核版本和 inventory 环境，损坏或变更自动回退原 CLI，安装、卸载、更新与启停同步失效。在本机 74 插件环境中，启动 inventory 与插件列表冷读约 1.6–3.7 秒，后续进程重载约 2ms，元数据逐项一致。首屏移除无消费方的 agents 全量读取，渠道元数据改为任务页按需加载；消除重复 assistant identity 请求。附件读取最多 4 个在途 worker，保持原顺序、共享帧预算和会话切换保护；修复旧轮次补拉定时器、同 tick 双历史探测及重复流气泡的重复归一化。模型设置重构为供应商目录、详情和添加三层工作台，密钥保存与异步生命周期更可靠；全部预置供应商参考品牌矢量源重新绘制为简洁单色图标，自定义供应商保留名称首字母。新增真实工具读取/编辑/命令展示、命令记录和可搜索快捷键目录，代码高亮不再破坏 Lit 节点。顶层页面、设置、任务和供应商切换统一为方向一致的短距离过渡，并完整支持 reduced-motion。看板减少滚动期 iframe 扫描、样式读取和背景模糊，Markdown 缓存增加总字符预算。构建复用有效 Chat UI 依赖 inventory，配置写前从同一原始快照生成独立副本，内核更新合并并发检查并阻止退出后的迟到换装或重启。四层测试默认并发提升为三层，完整门禁约 20 秒；发布继续保留构建、全量测试、隔离 UI、真实安装、更新发现和资产校验。
notes.en: Add cross-process snapshot caches for plugin loading, keyed by raw configuration, state directory, kernel version and inventory environment. Corrupt or stale entries fall back to the original CLI; install, uninstall, update and enable/disable operations invalidate both cache families. With 74 plugins on this machine, initial inventory/list reads take about 1.6–3.7 seconds and later process reloads about 2ms, with identical metadata. Remove an unused agents read from the first screen and load channel metadata only when Tasks opens. Reuse the admission assistant identity response. Bound attachment reads to four workers while preserving order, shared frame budgets and session-change guards. Fix stale-round retry timers, duplicate same-tick history probes and repeated normalization in stream duplicate detection. Rebuild Model Settings into provider catalog, detail and add views with safer key saving and async lifetimes. Redraw every preset provider as a simplified monochrome icon informed by brand vectors; custom providers retain their initial. Add real read/edit/command sheets, command history and searchable shortcuts, and prevent asynchronous highlighting from detaching Lit markers. Unify top-level, settings, task and provider navigation into short directional transitions with full reduced-motion support. Reduce dashboard iframe scans, style reads and backdrop blur during scrolling, and bound Markdown cache by total code units. Reuse valid Chat UI dependency inventories, parse two independent config snapshots from one raw read, coalesce kernel update checks and prevent late swaps/restarts after quitting. Run the four test layers with three-way concurrency for a roughly 20-second gate; builds, full tests, isolated UI, real install, update discovery and asset verification remain mandatory.

notes.zh: 升级并适配 OpenClaw 2026.10.9，同步六个官方渠道与模型插件版本，保留独立 Node 24.22.1 和物理网关；内核更新在私有暂存区准备匹配的官方插件后再发布，保留整树恢复与回滚。所有渠道插件遵循设置开关；未配置原生 Codex 模型时不加载其运行时，OpenAI 订阅账户统一从“启用并登录”进入。修复发送按钮、停止控件、迟到回复与重连状态；Enter 换行，Ctrl/Command+Enter 发送。模型选择即时反馈并顺序保存，发送等待对应模型生效。页面按需加载并合并重复读取，避免旧连接覆盖当前页面；配对列表复用原生属主流程，减少 CLI 初始化。优化安装目录接管、差分更新与运行资源裁剪。重做五张看板入门卡：四种主视觉示例、模板与提示词、排版和操作指引；额度环移至左侧图标轨，输入框显示上下文小圆环。看板预加载与可见动画分离，复用 iframe 并清理迟到事件；修复入门 CSS、离线缓存刷新及过期来源提示。归档、删除及移除卡片统一管理专属定时任务，绑定后启用在服务端协调，保留权限与任务版本检查。技能和插件仅手动检查更新。统一浮层交互：模型与思考强度菜单、额度环、会话更多菜单改为声明式开合，再次点击原路关闭，位置按可用空间自动翻转与夹取，浮层不再被面板裁切或压在低层级；侧栏悬停卡与内容区提升到对话框层级，侧栏分割线改为单条两端渐隐的细线。输入类控件统一为与输入框一致的柔和聚焦光环，移除各处硬描边。本版安装中位 120.5 秒，较 2026.1025.0 快 25.7%；安装包 316.6 MB，小 22.0%；安装后占用 940 MB，小 24.3%。本机六次冷启动实测：网关就绪中位 59.8 秒、完整可用中位 69.2 秒，分别快 12.5% 与 11.8%，退出中位 4.7 秒。
notes.en: Upgrade and adapt to OpenClaw 2026.10.9 with six matching official channel/provider plugins, standalone Node 24.22.1 and a physical gateway. Kernel updates prepare matching official plugins in private staging before publication, retaining whole-tree recovery and rollback. Channel plugins follow their settings switches. Native Codex stays unloaded without a native Codex model; OpenAI subscription accounts use the unified Enable and sign in entry. Fix Send, Stop, late replies and reconnection state. Enter inserts a newline; Ctrl/Command+Enter sends. Model selection updates immediately, saves in order and settles before sending. Load pages on demand, share duplicate reads and reject stale connection results. Pairing reads retain native owner admission while skipping full CLI initialization. Improve installer directory handover, differential updates and runtime resource trimming. Rebuild five onboarding cards with four example views, templates, prompt drafts, layout and interaction guidance. Move quota to the left rail and show a small context ring in the composer. Separate frame preloading from visible motion, retain iframe identity and retire stale callbacks. Fix onboarding CSS, offline refreshes and stale-source labels. Coordinate linked scheduled-task activation and archival/deletion on the server, with caller permissions and task revision checks. Skill and plugin update checks remain manual.Unify overlay interaction: the model/reasoning menu, quota ring and session more menu open declaratively and close on the same trigger, with adaptive placement that flips and clamps to available space so they are no longer clipped by panels or painted under lower layers. Rail hover cards and content columns move to the dialog tier, and the sidebar divider becomes a single fading hairline. Input controls share one soft focus halo with the composer, replacing hard outlines. Install median is 120.5 s, 25.7% faster than 2026.1025.0; the installer is 316.6 MB, 22.0% smaller; the installed tree is 940 MB, 24.3% smaller. Across six cold starts on this machine, gateway readiness medians 59.8 s and full usability 69.2 s, 12.5% and 11.8% faster, with a 4.7 s quit median.

notes.zh: 重做看板操作：标签右键提供编辑详情与删除，标题和说明作为模型上下文；常驻悬浮铅笔统一制作、布局和内容编辑，再次点击完成编辑，输入框出现时工具条自然上移。添加模块移入更多菜单，11个模块支持独立交互预览、尺寸对比和明确的示例数据。修复全屏被遮罩遮挡、收起闪屏及专注模式顶部遮挡；展开和快速往返保留同一运行文档与滚动位置。卡片按实际宽高响应，支持连续尺寸调节；整理保留阅读顺序和分区，平衡行宽与高度并可撤销。移除外层卡片悬浮聚焦，晶体背景跟随鼠标自然变化；丰富三日行程、清单和本机备注，尺寸示例动态显示布局文案。A股报价与历史曲线在原源连接失败时使用严格限定的备用数据源，保留实际来源、行情时间和旧缓存。深查对话发送、终止、附件准备与会话切换竞态，保留更新草稿和可恢复的后台失败消息，修复工具卡片重复与名称丢失。工作区与语言包按需加载，缩减入口解析；移除启动时无条件插件扫描，复用已完成的内核迁移标记；更新暂存避免重复复制将被替换的内核目录，继续保留备份、校验与回滚。精简重复源码和网页字体，更新README、图文官网和最新版实机演示。
notes.en: Redesign dashboards around one persistent pencil dock for model, layout and element editing, with a second click to finish and natural movement above the composer. Tab context menus edit title/description or delete a board; current details reach the model. More actions opens 11 interactive, isolated module previews with size comparison and labeled sample data. Fix hidden fullscreen widgets, restoration flicker and focus-mode titlebar overlap while keeping the same running document and scroll position through rapid transitions. Support responsive content, continuous sizing and reversible, ordered arrangement. Remove outer-card hover motion; add pointer-responsive crystals, a richer itinerary with local checklists/notes, and size-aware view labels. Recover built-in A-share quotes and history through a narrowly scoped alternate source, retaining provenance, quote time and stale-cache feedback. Audit send/abort/attachment/session races, preserve newer drafts and recoverable background failures, and fix duplicate or unnamed tool cards. Load views/languages on demand, remove unconditional plugin warmup, reuse completed migration authority, and avoid redundant core copying during update staging while retaining backup, verification and rollback. Prune duplicate sources, subset fonts, and refresh the illustrated website, README and actual-application demo.

notes.zh: 深度完善独立看板：参考完整演示重做 21 个示例模块的冰蓝、纸白与深墨层次，增加本机随手记、可编辑节奏、原创环境音、调色间及创作引导，用可暂停的晶体画布替换生硬字符装饰。看板复用对话页完整输入框，保留模型、附件、权限和停止操作；卡片可把想法填入输入框，由用户发送。展开与收起采用可打断的连续动画，对话框支持自然入场与退出；保留 iframe 和本机状态，离屏及减少动态效果时停止不必要工作。SDK v2 提供按帧动效、对话框和任务入口，保留 v1 兼容；刷新仅影响当前卡片。优化目录缓存、拖动按帧合并与 Canvas 位图复用，限制并发请求和桌面卡片数量。新增示例副本入口；看板可归档，也可经确认直接永久删除，两种操作都会先暂停明确属于该看板的关联任务并保留共享任务。内置技能按需提供设计、动效、数据、持久化和定时任务指导。修复票据 URL 日志脱敏和同 ID 卡片重建后的旧票据复用风险；诊断日志按尾部有界读取，安装包仅移除目标平台明确不兼容的 npm 二进制依赖。 合并输入框模型选择与思考强度为双层菜单，移除模型介绍，增加可逆开合、层级切换及键盘操作；菜单右上角提供内核会话级快速模式开关，按实际生效状态展示并保留未更改的 auto/ultrafast 设置。去掉看板输入框的重复白色外层，改为自然语言占位提示。修复旧 ASAR 自动配置遗留的失效向量 DLL 路径，保留自定义或仍可用的路径。区分启动前退出、日志写入失败和健康检查超时。历史 QA 会话与看板自动收尾并记录中断恢复所需的归属，刷新聊天列表。安装在同盘且目标为空时直接接管完整解压目录，失败仍走安全复制与重试；内核更新 staging 与网关同盘，减少一次整树复制，并为后续差分更新保持 app.asar 成员字节稳定。退出按子进程 exit 事件收尾，Windows 空闲 broker 不再额外等待固定回收计时，同时保留原生数据库和资源清理。升级 Vite 7.3.7 与 Vitest 4.1.12 修复开发依赖安全公告；同步修复 Undici 与 Zod 新公告，覆盖 OpenClaw、npm 和运行时内嵌副本，后续内核更新也会重新应用并校验这些安全版本。
notes.en: Deeply refine independent dashboards with 21 ice, paper and ink example modules inspired by the full reference demo, including local quick notes, an editable visual sequencer, original procedural soundscapes, palettes and creation recipes. Replace the rigid character art with a visibility-aware crystalline canvas. Reuse the complete Chat composer with models, attachments, permissions and stop; cards may fill a draft for the user to send. Add interruptible expansion/restoration and fluent composer entrance/exit while preserving iframe identity and local state. SDK v2 adds visibility-aware frame scheduling, composer and task entry points while retaining v1 compatibility. Card refresh is scoped to that card. Cache the catalogue, coalesce drag updates, reuse Canvas bitmaps and bound requests/pinned windows. Create fresh example copies without replacing user boards. Archive dashboards or permanently delete them after explicit confirmation; either operation pauses explicitly board-owned jobs first while preserving shared jobs. Extend compact on-demand skill guidance for design, motion, data, persistence and scheduling. Redact capability URLs from logs and prevent deleted/recreated cards from reviving old tickets. Read bounded log tails for diagnostics and prune only npm binary packages explicitly incompatible with the build target. Merge model and reasoning selection into one animated, keyboard-accessible menu, with no model descriptions and a session-scoped native fast-mode switch at the top right. Preserve inherited auto/ultrafast settings until changed. Remove the duplicate white dashboard composer shell and use a natural-language placeholder. Clear only missing vector-extension paths generated by the former ASAR auto-healer, preserving custom or working paths. Distinguish premature process exit, log-write failures and health timeouts. Automatically clean QA histories/boards, record ownership for interrupted-run recovery and refresh the session list. On the same volume, the installer adopts a complete extracted directory when the destination is empty, with the original copy/retry path as a fallback. Kernel updates stage beside the gateway to avoid another full-tree copy, while stable app.asar member bytes improve subsequent differential downloads. Shutdown now settles directly on the child exit event, and idle Windows brokers no longer add a fixed retirement wait; native database and resource cleanup remains intact. Update Vite to 7.3.7 and Vitest to 4.1.12 for published development-tool security fixes. Also patch the new Undici and Zod advisories across OpenClaw, npm and runtime copies; subsequent kernel updates reapply and verify the same protected versions.

notes.zh: 适配 OpenClaw 2026.10.6：捆绑独立 Node 24.22.1，网关改用物理目录，停止应用 ASAR 虚拟路径补丁；移除已被上游修复的全局 worker Proxy 清理补丁。Electron 更新至 43.8.3。按 10.6 公开构件接口适配显式可信搜索提供商；已审查的 Codex discovery 沿用内核选择性入口快照，减少整包复制并保留动态依赖、源变更与生命周期校验。Windows 路径规范化使用原生 API并保留大小、硬链接及边界检查；独立 Node 不再使用多余缓存退出钩子和 Electron ASAR 弃用告警静音。物理内核更新与回退支持整目录发布、换装日志及崩溃恢复；安装器只清理本安装目录的 Node 进程。OpenClaw 内核及飞书、Moonshot、Kimi、智谱、通义、DeepSeek 官方插件升级至 2026.10.6。修复 agent 数据库 schema 25 迁移识别及启动准备被配置发布竞态永久中断的问题；明确区分服务监听与会话可用，对已确认的准备期读取有界重试，写操作不重放。并发启动合并、锁文件进程身份校验、准确的错误分类与准备进度反馈提高首次启动可靠性。按内核版本和构建标识预设编译缓存目录，避免额外启动器；缓存同步落盘移出启动关键路径，Windows 增加 IPC 优雅停机并保留限时强制兜底。仪表盘重做为独立看板：最左侧入口、顶部多看板标签与新建、拖拽排序、角落缩放、整理、专注、放大与 Escape 返回、归档恢复和桌面置顶。内置 Hello World 示例提供蓝白黑自由布局、真实汇率与行情及日线图、官方发布画廊、待办与习惯打卡、持久化番茄钟、本机磁盘体检、音频队列及视频。内置 cryoclaw_dashboard 插件与短技能，模型通过工具发布交互卡片；独立 SQLite 存储保证模型与 UI 及时同步，保留布局和私有状态，刷新不调用模型。新增独立数据查询工具 cryoclaw_query_data，Agent 在普通对话中即可读取公共 API、本机状态和看板摘要，无需创建面板；返回来源、时间与有界正文，支持 JSON Pointer 精确选取。窗口缩小时整块画布与内容等比缩小，保持原列数和卡片布局。完善模块入场、图表描线、悬停反馈、计时呼吸及音频可视化，支持 Agent 自定义 CSS/SVG/Canvas 动效；离屏/后台暂停 CSS 动画，SDK 提供可见性及减少动态效果订阅。卡片可关联内核定时任务，查看运行状态、立即运行、暂停并解绑；新建任务先暂停，关联成功后启用，定时 Agent 原位更新同一卡片并保留用户布局和状态。公共数据支持代理 Fake-IP 独立解析、缓存和边界校验，生成文档保持沙盒隔离。新增内置交付插件工具 cryoclaw_deliver_files，模型只需调用短接口即可展示文件卡片；支持大小、可用状态、复制路径、另存和定位。保留 MEDIA 文字协议，同轮同文件优先插件且去重，修复渲染提交时机与卡片嵌套链接。执行上下文效率方案：5 个技能入口从 64,365 B 精简到 9,715 B，完整指导按需读取；新增缓存读写与未缓存输入统计、只读按需上下文指纹和重复备用模型诊断。20 秒启动仍为优化目标，具体冷/热启动实测及限制见仓库验收记录，不承诺所有配置均在 20 秒内可用。
notes.en: Adapt to OpenClaw 2026.10.6 with bundled Node 24.22.1 and a physical Gateway directory, removing ASAR-specific runtime patches and the worker Proxy sanitizer now fixed upstream. Update Electron to 43.8.3. Adapt explicit trusted search metadata to 10.6 public artifacts. Use the native selective-entry snapshot for the audited Codex discovery entry, preserving dynamic dependencies, source-change checks and lifecycle authority. Use native Windows canonicalization while retaining file-size, hardlink and boundary checks. Remove redundant native Node cache-exit hooks and Electron ASAR deprecation suppression. Physical kernel updates and rollbacks use whole-directory publication, a recovery journal and crash recovery. The installer scopes Node cleanup to this installation. Upgrade OpenClaw and official Feishu, Moonshot, Kimi, Zai, Qwen and DeepSeek plugins to 2026.10.6. Fix schema-25 migration detection and publication races that could permanently interrupt agent preparation. Distinguish listener health from usable sessions, retry explicit preparation reads within a deadline, and never replay writes. Coalesce concurrent starts, verify stale-lock process ownership and report accurate preparation progress and failures. Preselect the native version/build compile-cache namespace to avoid an extra launcher; move synchronous cache persistence off startup and add bounded graceful Windows IPC shutdown. Rebuild dashboards as independent workspaces with top tabs, creation, drag sorting, corner resizing, arrangement, focus, expansion, Escape restoration, archival and pinned desktop windows. The blue/white/black Hello World page includes real rates and market data with daily sparklines, official releases, persistent todos, habits and a Pomodoro timer, disk metrics, synthesized audio and video. The bundled cryoclaw_dashboard tool and compact skill publish interactive cards; private SQLite keeps model and UI instances synchronized while preserving layout and local state. Data refreshes use no model calls. The standalone cryoclaw_query_data tool reads public APIs, local metrics and dashboard summaries from any task without creating a panel, with provenance, bounded output and JSON Pointer selection. Window resizing scales the fixed design canvas and contents proportionally while preserving columns and card layout. Improve module entrances, chart drawing, hover feedback, timer breathing and audio visualization. Agents can design CSS/SVG/Canvas motion; offscreen/background CSS animations pause and the SDK exposes visibility/reduced-motion subscriptions. Cards link to native cron jobs with run status, run-now, pause/unlink and schedule creation. Jobs start paused, enable after binding, and scheduled agents update the same card while preserving user layout and state. Bounded public-source fetching supports independently checked Fake-IP resolution, caching and sandbox isolation. The bundled cryoclaw_deliver_files tool publishes local deliverables as cards through a compact interface. Cards support availability, sizes, copying paths, saving copies and revealing files. Legacy MEDIA remains supported; successful plugin receipts take precedence for the same file in the same assistant turn. Fix post-commit metadata binding and nested path links. Slim five skill entrypoints from 64,365 to 9,715 bytes while retaining detailed on-demand guidance. Add explicit cache read/write and uncached-input metrics plus on-demand context fingerprints and duplicate-fallback diagnostics. Twenty seconds remains a startup target; measured cold/warm results and limits are documented in the repository rather than guaranteed for every configuration.

notes.zh: 修复 Gateway 反复启动后先失败再自愈：健康检查超时后不再立刻杀掉仍在加载的慢热子进程，改为一次性宽限续等，冷启动首次即可成功；旧实例停止改为并行解析端口进程、超时即强杀，系统守护进程清理按版本只执行一次，启动更快。修复设置页记忆/配对操作与开发模式下启动时一闪而过的命令行窗口，并新增静态守卫防止回归。修复主题页拖放冲突：悬停参考图区时不再同时亮起「导入主题包」，拖入非图片不再卡死高亮或误导入，图片拖到参考区外不再误报。本轮改动胶囊悬停详情精简为文件名与逐文件增删行数；流式回复完成后在消息底部展示「已编辑 N 个文件」卡片，支持撤销与查看变更。
notes.en: Fix Gateway repeatedly failing first and self-healing on retry: a slow-but-alive child is no longer killed at the health-check timeout but granted a one-time grace period, so cold starts succeed on the first attempt. Stopping a stale instance now resolves the port owner in parallel and force-kills sooner, legacy daemon cleanup runs once per app version, and startup is faster. Fix the flashing console window from settings memory/pairing fallbacks and dev-mode startup, with a static guard against regressions. Fix theme-page drag conflicts: hovering the reference-image area no longer keeps the theme-package overlay lit, dropping non-images no longer sticks the highlight or imports by mistake, and images dropped elsewhere no longer raise an error. The turn-changes pill hover detail now shows just file names with per-file added/deleted lines; when a reply finishes, an Edited-files card with Undo and View changes appears at the bottom of the message.

notes.zh: 技能与插件支持本地目录导入和本地文档详情；本地项目不参与更新检查。插件更新检查直接查询市场或 npm，支持逐项检查、更新和详情；技能更新使用正确的 update 命令。修复 ASAR 内核跳过 OpenClaw SDK 链接导致 tavily、企业微信更新失败的问题。市场请求合并在途读取，国内镜像延迟竞速，下载沿用可达来源；软件更新直接读取发布清单，并支持 HTTPS 镜像目录。外观页增加双模式文字对比度检查，修复预览保存的明暗模式和主题库损坏保护，统一折叠与主题切换动效，精简 Agent 主题设计流程。 重做 Agent 主题设计入口：主描述、配色方向卡、可折叠精细设置、参考图侧栏及确认流程；离开页面后保留设计草稿。修复启动时搜索凭据元数据误加载完整插件运行时造成的长时间等待。 修复工具调用合并后多出的空白 Tool 卡片、缺名事件覆盖工具名及历史结果配对问题。
notes.en: Import local skill and plugin folders and read their documentation locally; local items stay outside update checks. Plugin checks query the marketplace or npm directly, with per-item checks, updates and details. Skill upgrades use the update command. Fix ASAR OpenClaw SDK links required by Tavily and WeCom plugin updates. Marketplace reads share in-flight requests and race the existing China mirror after a short delay; skill downloads reuse the reachable source. App updates read release manifests directly and support HTTPS mirror directories. Appearance adds paired-palette contrast checks, correct preview mode persistence and corrupt-library protection, smoother disclosures and theme transitions, and a shorter Agent theme workflow. Redesign the Agent theme brief with a focused prompt, palette direction cards, optional fine controls, reference sidebar and clear preview handoff. Preserve the brief across navigation. Read trusted search metadata through its public contract to avoid unrelated runtime loading at startup. Fix empty duplicate Tool cards, preserve names on incremental tool events and correctly pair historical tool results.

notes.zh: 优化工作空间、用量和语音的首次打开：增加空闲预加载、连接隔离缓存、在途请求合并与写后刷新；工作空间直接读取本地路径上下文。重做首次使用引导：具名进度、安装检查重试、模型验证与保存分阶段反馈、在途表单保护、可恢复的登录和启动流程、持续错误提示及窄窗操作栏。完善任务编辑的启用状态、描述、超时、投递、时区和精确间隔保留，修复旧请求覆盖和无操作保存。完成四轮布局、三轮交互及多轮功能调试。四层全量测试统一编排、有限并发和独立日志；UI发版门禁合并为一次启动，保留操作等待、真实数据就绪和关键失败场景验收。
notes.en: Workspace, Usage and Voice now warm data in idle time, share in-flight reads and use connection-scoped caches with refresh after writes. Workspace paths resolve locally. First-time setup gains named progress, retryable installation checks, separate verification and saving feedback, protected forms, recoverable sign-in and startup, persistent errors and actions that remain visible in short windows. Task editing preserves enabled state, metadata, timeouts, delivery, timezones and exact intervals; stale responses and no-op saves are fixed. Layout, interaction and functional reviews were completed across the app. The four test layers now share bounded orchestration and separate logs. Release UI checks use one app launch while waiting for actions, transitions and real data, with focused failure-path coverage.

notes.zh: 工作区草稿备份失败时保留当前编辑，备份期间的新输入继续保存；快速切换根目录保持前后端一致，失败后可重试。会话选择与管理按钮分离，菜单支持方向键和 Escape，文件标签支持键盘切换。工作区与技能选择文案统一进入中英字典。安装验收自动暂存安装器，发布下载增加超时、容量与重定向限制，流式核对安装包摘要；新增服务端资产摘要校验和默认只预览的过期产物清理工具，整理当前交接与历史文档。 修复 Inter 字体注册，并更新 Electron 与可兼容升级的依赖。
notes.en: Keep workspace edits when draft backup fails and persist edits made while a backup is pending. Root changes remain ordered across the UI and main process, with retryable failures. Session selection and action buttons are separate native controls; menus and file tabs support keyboard navigation. Workspace and skill-picker text now uses the bilingual dictionaries. Installer verification stages a fresh executable; release downloads have time, size and redirect limits with streaming hashes. Added server-digest verification, preview-first stale artifact cleanup, and a concise handoff with archived history. Restores Inter font registration and updates Electron and compatible dependencies.

notes.zh: 修复工作区快速切换文件及放弃草稿时的异步竞争，避免旧操作覆盖新选择。Worktrees 列表仅接受最新请求与当前连接的结果。更新暂缓在写盘失败时仍在本次会话生效，清除暂缓后立即恢复自动检查。完善发布资产的大小、校验和与多架构一致性校验，并为验收工具补齐断线与超时处理。
notes.en: Fix races when switching workspace files or discarding drafts, keeping later selections intact. Worktree lists accept only the latest request from the current connection. Update snooze remains effective for the session if persistence fails, and clearing it resumes automatic checks. Release validation now checks asset sizes, checksums and architecture consistency; smoke tools handle disconnects and timeouts.

notes.zh: 交互与主题修复批次。DeepSeek 等按量付费提供商只显示余额：即使上游误报窗口，也绝不渲染「每周额度」，面板标题按余额/额度语义切换；输入框余额圆环改为单行显示、按余额充裕度着色，并附非限额百分比说明。本轮改动胶囊去掉左右图标、居中显示 git 新增/删除行数（无 git 时退回文件数），任务进度卡回到最贴近输入框的位置，改动浮层改用消息内容层、不再压过其他浮层。工具卡参数与长 JSON 不再撑破聊天列，点「输入参数」不再误开右侧输出面板。主题包新增可选间距密度、阴影强度、边框粗细与描述字段，支持拖放导入与按主题名导出；「让 Agent 设计主题」改为填空式表单并支持参考图（随消息发送，不写入主题包）。整体 UI 修复 13 项：固定工作区样式/点击区/焦点、800px 下固定工作区可见、Worktrees 工具行换行、概览标签大小写、用量页加载占位与无障碍、窄窗输入区工具栏换行等。
notes.en: Interaction and theme fix batch. Pay-as-you-go providers such as DeepSeek show balance only: even if an upstream misreports windows, a weekly quota is never rendered, and the panel title follows balance vs. limit semantics. The composer balance ring is now single-line, colored by balance health, and explains that it is not a percentage of a limit. The turn-changes pill drops its side icons, centers, and shows git additions/deletions (falling back to file counts when git is unavailable); the progress card sits closest to the composer, and the changes popover moves to the message content layer so it no longer covers other overlays. Tool-card arguments and long JSON no longer burst the chat column, and expanding Input no longer pops the output sidebar. Theme packages gain optional spacing density, shadow strength, border width and description fields, drag-and-drop import and name-based export; Let an agent design a theme is now a fill-in-the-blank form with reference images (sent with the message, never stored in the package). Thirteen UI fixes: pinned-workspace styling/hit areas/focus, the pin-workspace button at 800px, wrapping worktree toolbars, overview label casing, usage loading placeholders and accessibility, and a wrapping composer toolbar in narrow windows.

notes.zh: 升级 OpenClaw 至 2026.10.4，同步官方提供商插件。修复模型能力保存时缺少数组替换声明，默认模型设置即时显示进度，配置刷新保留模型卡片。操作通知统一为底部悬浮提示，按信息、成功、警告、错误区分颜色。默认浅色主题使用纯黑正文和纯白面板；主题包扩展气泡、图标、输入区等角色颜色和控件微调。修复 Kimi 额度、API 余额和切换模型后的额度刷新。命令补全支持原生命令参数、已配置模型、光标位置和输入法；工作区新建对话将目录传给内核，Git 切换仓库隔离迟到写入响应。文件变更移至输入框上方胶囊，右上角改为会话信息面板，展示工作区、子智能体与来源文件。缩减消息下方空白，修复快速转场中断异常，减少滚动和主题扫描的重复工作。
notes.en: Upgraded OpenClaw and official provider plugins to 2026.10.4. Fixed capability saves with explicit nested array replacement paths. Default-model changes show immediate progress and model cards remain visible during refresh. Operation feedback uses color-coded global bottom notifications. Default light appearance uses black body text and white panels; theme packages gain bubble, icon and composer colors plus component refinements. Fixed Kimi usage, API balance display and quota refresh on model changes. Command completion supports native arguments, configured models, caret position and IME. Workspace conversations pass their directory to the kernel; Git mutations discard stale responses after repository switches. Turn file changes appear above the composer; a conversation information panel replaces the legacy plan overlay. Reduced message-action spacing, handled interrupted transitions and removed redundant scroll and theme scans.

notes.zh: 模型设置整合订阅账户、主模型概览、辅助/决策模型与备用链，支持搜索、分组折叠和更多供应商额度查询；对话输入框同步展示额度，未知时弱化显示。外观设置新增 MiSans 可变字体、连续字重与精确滑块，四套成对深浅主题、主题包导入导出、可撤销预览和可视化元素编辑；Agent 可从外观页进入主题设计，内置技能具备检查、重试和错误修复引导。工作区支持多根目录、文件搜索、编辑保存、草稿恢复与外部修改冲突保护；技能引用支持搜索和键盘操作，附件展示图片缩略图与文件卡片。优化页面预载、连续转场、控件与图标，消息操作按钮移到正文下方；网关就绪后自动刷新记忆状态。备份导入导出增加阶段进度，统一流式归档上限并修复大文件失败；内核支持在线稳定版本钉定。Windows 更新修复已关闭应用仍提示占用的问题，安装器启动失败可恢复。
notes.en: Model settings bring subscription accounts, a primary-model overview, utility and decision roles, ordered fallbacks, search and collapsible provider groups together. More providers support usage queries, with a subtle unknown state in the composer. Appearance adds MiSans variable typography, continuous weights, precise sliders, four paired light/dark themes, theme import/export, reversible previews and visual element editing. Agents can start theme design from Appearance using the bundled skill with checks, retries and repair guidance. Workspaces support multiple roots, file search, editing, durable drafts and external-change protection. Skill references gain search and keyboard navigation; attachments show thumbnails and file cards. Improved page preloading, continuous transitions, controls and icons; message actions appear below content. Memory status refreshes after gateway readiness. Backup import/export reports phase progress and supports larger streaming archives. Kernel updates resolve online stable pins. Windows upgrades recover from false app-running prompts and installer launch failures.

notes.zh: 新增 OpenAI / Codex 独立代理：环境代理、直连、自定义 HTTP(S) 三种方式，支持测试隧道和保存重连，登录期间防止误切换。仅固定官方域名经过独立代理，浏览器授权页使用浏览器自身网络。模型账户与更新体验改进：设置中的模型页接入 OpenClaw 原生 ChatGPT / Codex 订阅登录、模型目录和额度同步，内核负责保存及刷新凭据，订阅模型无需填写 API Key；优化窄屏布局、弹窗键盘操作、长文滚动与退场动效，修复重复点击和迟到请求导致的状态异常。Windows 更新时旧卸载器失败会立即进入恢复流程，修复应用已关闭仍提示未关闭、必须取消后才继续的问题；安装器启动失败保留应用并显示错误，卸载 PATH 清理不再执行共享临时脚本。备份导入增加条目、解压大小与目录元数据限制，Rust 和 JavaScript 实现保持一致。 登录后显示账户状态、套餐额度和模型管理，支持模型名称、默认项、流式输出与高级参数，保存后自动折叠；代理设置默认收起。首次授权触发共享凭据迁移时自动重连恢复模型状态。任务页空态保持整页宽度，切页与设置导航加入连续过渡并尊重减少动态效果；网关在启动期间提前保存编译缓存，减少强制退出后的重复编译。
notes.en: Added an independent OpenAI / Codex proxy with environment, direct and custom HTTP(S) modes, tunnel testing and save/reconnect. Changes are disabled during sign-in. Only fixed official service origins are routed; external authorization pages use browser network settings. Model accounts and update experience: Settings now integrates OpenClaw-native ChatGPT / Codex subscription sign-in, model catalog and usage-limit synchronization. The kernel owns credential persistence and refresh; subscription models require no API key. Improved narrow layouts, modal keyboard access, long-content scrolling and dismissal animations; fixed duplicate actions and stale asynchronous state. Windows upgrades immediately enter recovery when a legacy uninstaller fails, fixing the false app-still-running prompt that previously required Cancel. Installer spawn failures keep the app open and show an error; uninstall PATH cleanup no longer runs a shared temporary script. Backup imports enforce entry-count, output-size and directory-metadata limits consistently across Rust and JavaScript. Signed-in accounts show connection state, subscription limits and model settings with aliases, defaults, streaming and advanced parameters. Model settings collapse after saving, and proxy settings start collapsed. A one-time reconnect recovers catalog state after first-login credential migration. Task empty states retain the full page width; navigation transitions respect reduced motion. Startup compilation caches are flushed before forced shutdowns to reduce repeated compilation.

notes.zh: 对话体验八项批次：流式重复根治 + 工具调用合并与结果展示 + 子会话卡片回归 + 动效补全防丢 + 回底按钮修复 + 固定工作区（新）+ 内核 2026.10.3 全面适配 + 审查修复。① 流式消息重复根治（必现）：同一条助手消息在 DOM 渲染两份，根因是流式段与历史收养的归属判定不严；现按 runId 精确匹配 + 时间戳归属双重校验剔除在途同文条目，终态全文以本地占位保住到历史收敛，一条回复不再出现两个气泡。② 工具调用合并收纳：连续 ≥2 次同名工具调用合并为一个折叠组（跨工具不合并、时序不重排），组头标 ×N 计数与参数摘要，展开逐条可查；结果展示补齐折叠/语法高亮/摘要提取/状态差异化（成功·失败·截断分色），长输出标「共 N 行」并保留完整查看入口。③ 子会话卡片回归修复：派生子会话状态卡恢复，侧边栏按 spawnedBy 谱系嵌套，消息内新增可点引用卡跳转子会话；多级派生链递归展开（孙会话此前被整条丢弃，已修），谱系成环或父会话跨时间组时兜底顶层可达。④ 动效补全与防丢失：退场两段式（动画播完才移除 DOM）覆盖会话菜单/工作区弹窗/抽屉弹层，菜单二级模式的复位推迟到退场结束（此前淡出途中会跳回上级菜单），补齐各页缺失的入场过渡，reduced-motion 全量降级。⑤ 回到底部按钮修复：向上滚动即显（不等新消息到达），点击平滑滚动到底；平滑动画在途加守卫窗口——动画自身的中间 scroll 事件不再被误判为用户上滚，杜绝「刚点掉的按钮在动画途中重新亮起」与流式贴底跟流中断。⑥ 固定工作区（新功能）：工作区 = 路径 + 名称 + 图标，可自建并用系统目录选择器选路径（新增 dialog:select-directory IPC，与既有通道同款可信发送方校验）；会话可一对一可选绑定，会话列表按工作区分组、未绑定会话保持原置顶/时间分组，工作区旁一键在该工作区新建会话，会话「⋯」菜单新增「指定工作区」二级选择（含「无工作区」解绑）；配置持久化在本地设置，绑定到已删除工作区的脏数据自动回落未分组，归档/搜索态平铺不分组。⑦ 内核 2026.10.3 全面适配：逐方法核对 506 个注册 RPC 与 61 个广播事件，仓库调用面零缺口（RPC 审计基线随版本更新）；对齐 2026.10.2 typed /stop 语义——已连接会话中键入 /stop 同时清空客户端排队 follow-up（Stop 按钮仍只中止当前 run，离线补发不变）；配置迁移规则与差分换装链路复核无需改动。⑧ 审查修复：多级派生链会话丢失（P0）、平滑滚动在途状态翻转（P1）、归档/搜索空态提示被工作区数量误门控（P1）全部修复，并消除绑定逻辑的重复实现。经全量测试（vitest 268 / node 326 / chat-ui 948 / scripts 137）与双端类型检查。
notes.en: Eight-part chat experience batch: streaming duplication fix, tool-call grouping and result display, subsession card regression, motion completion, scroll-to-bottom fix, pinned workspaces (new), full kernel 2026.10.3 adaptation, and review fixes. (1) Streaming duplication root-fixed (was always reproducible): the same assistant message rendered twice in the DOM because streamed segments and history adoption were attributed too loosely; in-flight identical entries are now stripped only after an exact runId match plus a timestamp-ownership check, and the terminal full text is held as a local placeholder until history converges, so one reply no longer produces two bubbles. (2) Tool-call grouping: runs of 2+ consecutive same-name calls collapse into one foldable group (no cross-tool merging, chronological order preserved) with an xN count and argument digest in the header; result display gains folding, syntax highlighting, summary extraction, and status differentiation (success/failure/truncation color-coded), long outputs state their line count and keep a full-output affordance. (3) Subsession card regression fixed: spawned-session status cards are back, the sidebar nests by spawnedBy lineage, and messages gain a clickable reference card that jumps to the child session; multi-level spawn chains now expand recursively (grandchildren were previously dropped entirely), with a top-level fallback when the lineage cycles or the parent sits in another time group. (4) Motion completion and loss prevention: two-phase dismissal (DOM removed only after the exit animation) now covers the session menu, workspace dialog, drawers and popovers; the menu's second-level mode resets only when the exit finishes (it used to flip back to the parent menu mid-fade); missing entrance transitions were added across pages, with full reduced-motion fallbacks. (5) Scroll-to-bottom fixed: the pill appears as soon as you scroll up (no longer waits for a new message) and clicking it smooth-scrolls to the bottom; an in-flight guard window means the animation's own intermediate scroll events are no longer misread as the user scrolling up, killing both the pill reappearing mid-animation and the broken stick-to-bottom follow during streaming. (6) Pinned workspaces (new): a workspace is a path plus a name and icon, user-created with the native directory picker (new dialog:select-directory IPC behind the same trusted-sender assertion as its neighbors); sessions bind to a workspace one-to-one and optionally, the session list groups bound sessions by workspace while unbound ones keep the existing pinned/time grouping, a button beside each workspace creates a session inside it, and the session overflow menu gains an assign-workspace second level including an unbind entry; the mapping persists in local settings, bindings to deleted workspaces fall back to ungrouped, and archived/search views stay flat. (7) Kernel 2026.10.3 fully adapted: all 506 registered RPC methods and 61 broadcast events were checked one by one against the repo call surface with zero gaps (the RPC audit baseline moves with the version); typed /stop now matches 2026.10.2 semantics by also clearing client-side queued follow-ups in a connected session (the Stop button still aborts only the current run, offline replay unchanged); the config-migration rules and the differential asar swap pipeline were reviewed and need no change. (8) Review fixes: multi-level spawn chains dropping sessions (P0), smooth-scroll in-flight state flipping (P1), and the archived/search empty-state hint being wrongly gated on workspace count (P1) are all fixed, plus a duplicated bind implementation removed. Verified by the full suite (vitest 268 / node 326 / chat-ui 948 / scripts 137) and both typechecks.

notes.zh: 归档 sidecar v0.2.0 + 阶段二全量批次（性能/更新/WebBridge/概览页/类型化）。① 归档 sidecar 0.2.0：导入与校验改走交互式单会话——sidecar 解析 zip 后回发清单、JS 校验白名单回写、同进程同句柄解压，zip 只解析一遍（此前 validate+import 全流程 4 遍解析 5 次 spawn），同时消除两次调用间文件被替换的 TOCTOU 窗口；导出补齐 progress 事件（协议能力空转修复）且输出改 256KB 缓冲写；修复 Windows 上文件/目录 mtime 恢复静默失败（SetFileTime 需 FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES 句柄，目录还需 BACKUP_SEMANTICS，原只读打开恒失败，与 JS 后端行为漂移）；同目录多文件的父目录规范化校验缓存去重；create 条目名补绝对路径/盘符/越界段纵深拒绝。② 性能与内存：渲染层长列表与分组渲染减负、流式状态去抖、主进程周期任务降频。③ 安装与更新：差异更新链路重启加固，新增 release 资产断言脚本（exe+blockmap+latest.yml 同批校验，杜绝半截发布）。④ WebBridge 解耦：浏览器插件钉定与校验改由定时 workflow 自动对齐上游最新版（schema v3 + CRX 运行时更新管线），不再随 CryoClaw 发版。⑤ 内置件全量升级：内核 2026.10.3、OfficeCLI 1.0.157，全部插件走自动 bump 链。⑥ 设置页「环境信息」重构为「概览」：hero 区（版本+网关状态灯+运行时长）、六格统计、内存双段条、运行时/网关/路径三卡（一键复制），并突出 openclaw 专属信息（内核可更新/回退状态、技能与插件计数、内核目录与网关日志路径）。⑦ tab-provider 配置写入全量类型化（patchConfig 泛型 + OpenclawConfigDraft 投影，29 处 as any 清零）。经全量测试（vitest 268 / node 326 / chat-ui 909 / scripts 133）+ Rust cargo 9 项 + 双 backend 契约测试 + 真机冒烟。
notes.en: Archive sidecar v0.2.0 plus the phase-2 batch (performance, updates, WebBridge, Overview page, typing). (1) Archive sidecar 0.2.0: import and validate now run as one interactive session - the sidecar parses the zip, emits the manifest, JS validates the whitelist and writes it back, and extraction continues in the same process on the same open handle, so the archive is parsed exactly once (previously four full parses and five spawns across validate+import) and the replace-between-calls TOCTOU window is gone; exports finally emit progress events (a protocol capability that sat idle) through a 256KB buffered writer; fixed silent mtime-restore failure on Windows (SetFileTime needs a FILE_WRITE_ATTRIBUTES handle, directories also need BACKUP_SEMANTICS - the old read-only open always failed and drifted from the JS backend); per-parent canonicalization checks are now cached across same-directory files; create-side entry names reject absolute paths, drive letters, and traversal segments as defense in depth. (2) Performance and memory: lighter long-list and grouped rendering, debounced streaming state, lower-frequency main-process timers. (3) Install and update: the differential update pipeline is restarted and hardened, with a new release-asset assertion (exe + blockmap + latest.yml in one batch - no half-published releases). (4) WebBridge decoupling: browser-extension pins and verification now track upstream latest via a scheduled workflow (schema v3 + CRX runtime update pipeline), independent of CryoClaw releases. (5) Bundled components: kernel 2026.10.3, OfficeCLI 1.0.157, all plugins on the automated bump chain. (6) Settings "Environment" rebuilt as "Overview": hero (version + gateway status pill + uptime), six-stat strip, dual-segment memory bar, runtime/gateway/paths cards with one-click copy, and openclaw-specific facts front and center (kernel update/rollback state, skill and plugin counts, kernel dir and gateway log paths). (7) Provider-config writes fully typed (generic patchConfig + OpenclawConfigDraft projection; 29 as-any casts removed). Verified by the full suite (vitest 268 / node 326 / chat-ui 909 / scripts 133), 9 Rust cargo tests, dual-backend contract tests, and a live smoke run.

notes.zh: 动效系统定型 + 工具调用收纳 + 布局抛光批次。① 动效「一镜到底」：元素不再瞬现瞬消——toast 沿底部来路退场（新增离场两段式：动画播完才移除 DOM）；抽屉与设置弹窗补上入场（此前瞬现瞬隐）；全局 .btn/.icon-btn 新增按压回缩反馈（reduced-motion 下显式关闭，防瞬跳）；19 处 hover 补齐过渡（全局弹窗关闭钮、会话项操作、折叠摘要行、错误卡重发等——此前悬停颜色硬切）；面板开合/视图入场/消息入场等 11 处统一走 --ease-standard 规范曲线；流式光标由硬闪烁改平滑呼吸；工具组完成标记轻弹衔接 spinner；折叠高度动画扩到工具参数/文件变更/JSON 块（开合不再瞬变）。② 工具调用收纳：连续 ≥3 次同类调用自动合并为子折叠行（如连读 5 个文件收成「读取文件 ×5 · a.ts, b.ts +3」，时序保持不重排）；单工具多次调用在折叠行标 ×N 计数；长输出附「共 N 行」规模提示，截断输出保留完整查看入口。③ 布局修复与统一：任务列表行与 worktree 创建面板的 padding 因引用不存在的 --spacer-14 整条失效塌零，已修复并补行 hover；tasks/settings/worktrees/git 四视图内容列统一 --content-wide（消除跨视图切换时的列宽跳变），页边距统一 --page-gutter；任务筛选/worktrees/git/技能商店四处「一行字」空态升级为图标+标题；about 页版本信息、技能卡元信息、cron 详情值统一等宽 11px 元信息排版；设置页标题 20px→18px 与其余面板对齐；21px/22px/5px 等非阶梯间距贴回 4px 基网。④ 清理：删除从未被调用的 skill-store toast（含 CSS/视图/状态三处）、与基础规则等值的 .chat-error-card:hover 死规则、与 rise 逐帧等价的 oc-view-enter 重复关键帧。⑤ 规范沉淀：CLAUDE.md 新增写作风格约定（更新日志/注释/文档：结论先行、简洁精确、老练可轻幽默）与「一镜到底」动效原则入 design-guidelines。经全量测试（vitest 310 / chat-ui 909 / scripts 136）与类型检查。
notes.en: Motion system finalization + tool-call grouping + layout polish batch. (1) Motion now follows a one-continuous-take principle: elements no longer pop in or vanish — toasts exit back down the way they came (new two-phase dismissal: the DOM node is removed only after the exit animation), the provider drawer and settings modals finally have entrance animations (they previously blinked in and out), all .btn/.icon-btn controls get a subtle press-scale feedback (explicitly suppressed under reduced motion to avoid jump-cut scaling), 19 hover states that used to hard-snap now transition (dialog close buttons, session-item actions, collapse summaries, error-card resend, and friends), and 11 panel/entrance animations were unified onto the spec easing curve. The streaming caret breathes smoothly instead of hard-blinking, tool-group completion badges pop in instead of replacing the spinner mid-frame, and height-collapse animations now cover tool args, file changes, and JSON blocks. (2) Tool-call grouping: runs of 3+ consecutive same-name calls collapse into a sub-row (five consecutive file reads become "Read file x5 - a.ts, b.ts +3"), preserving chronological order; single-tool groups show a xN count; long outputs now state their line count, with the full-output affordance kept for truncated ones. (3) Layout: fixed a real rendering bug where task rows and the worktree-create panel referenced a nonexistent --spacer-14 token, silently zeroing their padding; the four form/list views (tasks/settings/worktrees/git) now share one content column and gutter so switching views no longer shifts edges; four one-line empty states upgraded to icon + title; version info, skill-card meta, and cron detail values now use the mono 11px meta convention; settings section titles align to 18px with the other panels; stray off-grid spacings snapped back to the 4px grid. (4) Cleanup: removed the skill-store toast that was never called (CSS, view branch, and state field), a dead error-card hover rule identical to its base, and a duplicate view-enter keyframe. (5) Conventions: CLAUDE.md gains a writing-style rule (changelogs/comments/docs: outcome first, concise, seasoned with light humor) and the design guidelines record the one-take motion principle. Full suite green (vitest 310 / chat-ui 909 / scripts 136) plus typecheck.

notes.zh: 七项批次：切换会话不断流 + 流式/终态输出修复 + Rust 归档提速 4-12 倍 + 内核 2026.9.9 + 动效与 UI 框架优化 + 三路审查修复。① 切换会话不再断流：切走时保存 run 态快照（流式正文/思考流/解说/工具时间线/排队消息/计划面板），后台事件持续累积进快照，切回无损恢复——此前切走即丢工具时间线与排队消息，切回只能靠历史收养部分重建；滚动位置按会话记忆，贴底会话切回继续贴底跟流。② 流式重复与终态输出修复：在途 run 时剔除内核中途落盘与流式同文的重复条目（带时钟容忍的归属判定，防误删上一轮回复）；终态后回复全文（含工具前正文）以本地占位保住直到历史收敛，滞后快照等长场景按「终态证据」从严判定并按轮次复位补拉预算，杜绝「问了没答」；已终结 run 的迟到快照拒收养（tombstone）。③ 排队消息错投防护：发送窗口内切换会话且发送失败时，条目归还原会话队列而非当前会话（杜绝 A 的排队消息发进 B）；删除活跃会话的本地快照清理时序修正。④ Rust 归档 sidecar（新增，v0.1.1）：.openclaw 状态归档导出/校验/导入改走 Rust sidecar（路径白名单等安全校验仍在 JS 侧，任何失败静默回退原 JS 实现，行为等价）——实测导出 4.2x（623→148ms）、校验 12x（682→57ms）、导入 8.5x（1403→165ms）；sidecar 内建解压内存上限、zip 结构防御、会话空闲看门狗与版本 pin 比对，打包期硬校验 sidecar 存在。⑤ 内核 2026.9.7 → 2026.9.9：逐字节取证确认零破坏性变化（RPC/事件面/schema 一致），stable 渠道推进。⑥ 动效：循环动画时长统一令牌化（含流式光标）、spring 曲线入场、reduced-motion 全覆盖、shimmer 改合成器路径。⑦ UI 框架：消息分组 content-visibility 渐进渲染、导航 tab 收敛（已删虚拟路径 popState 回写）、对话页视图层拆分（1760→613 行）、isRecord 七份合并、死代码清理。经全量测试（vitest 266 / node 310 / chat-ui 905 / scripts 136）、Rust cargo 测试与双 backend 契约测试，及三路并行代码审查（4 P1 + 19 P2 全部修复或记录）。
notes.en: Seven-part batch: uninterrupted session switching, streaming/terminal-output fixes, a Rust archive sidecar (4-12x faster), kernel 2026.9.9, motion and UI-framework optimization, and a three-lane review pass. (1) Switching sessions no longer interrupts runs: a per-session run-state snapshot (streaming text / thinking / narration / tool timeline / queued messages / plan panel) keeps accumulating background events while you are away and restores losslessly on return - previously the tool timeline and queued messages were dropped on switch and only partially rebuilt via history adoption; scroll positions are remembered per session and pinned-to-bottom sessions keep following the stream. (2) Streaming duplicate and terminal-output fixes: while a run is in flight, kernel-side progressive persists that duplicate the streamed text are stripped (with a clock-skew-tolerant ownership check so last round's reply is never removed); after a terminal event the full reply (including pre-tool text) is kept as a local placeholder until history converges, stale equal-length snapshots are judged strictly on terminal evidence with a per-round retry budget - no more 'asked but no answer'; late snapshots of already-terminated runs are refused via tombstones. (3) Queued-message misdelivery guard: if you switch sessions while a queued send is in flight and it fails, the item returns to the original session's queue, never the current one; deleting the active session now cleans local snapshots after the reconcile step. (4) Rust archive sidecar (new, v0.1.1): .openclaw state export/validate/import now run on a Rust sidecar (path-whitelist security checks stay in JS; any failure silently falls back to the original JS implementation with identical behavior) - measured export 4.2x (623→148ms), validate 12x (682→57ms), import 8.5x (1403→165ms); the sidecar carries a streaming decompression cap, zip-structure defenses, a session idle watchdog, and version-pin comparison, and packaging hard-verifies the sidecar for win32-x64. (5) Kernel 2026.9.7 → 2026.9.9: byte-level recon confirms zero breaking changes (RPC/event surface and schema identical); the stable channel advances. (6) Motion: loop durations unified behind a token (including the streaming caret), spring-curve entrances, full reduced-motion coverage, shimmer moved to compositor-friendly transforms. (7) UI framework: content-visibility progressive rendering for message groups, tab convergence (deleted virtual paths rewrite the URL on popState), the chat view split from 1760 to 613 lines, isRecord merged from seven copies, dead code removed. Verified by the full suite (vitest 266 / node 310 / chat-ui 905 / scripts 136), Rust cargo tests plus dual-backend contract tests, and a three-lane parallel code review (4 P1 + 19 P2 all fixed or recorded).

notes.zh: 八项修复与体验批次：插件商店/技能商店安装报错根治 + Gateway 启动提速与进度展示 + 任务页适配新内核重建 + 全局动效与稳定性提升。① 商店安装/更新不再报 does not recognize option：ack 确认旗标对齐 2026.9.7 内核（--acknowledge-install-policy-warning），并对旧内核做 新旗标→旧旗标→无旗标 逐级降级重试（无 ack 旗标的非交互调用会撞 install policy 失败，不能一次剥光）；插件更新检查超时 90s→180s，超时且列表缓存还热时自动走 ClawHub HTTP 兜底重查（版本表同源自取，不再回源 CLI 二次等待），失败文案按超时/网络/配置分档成人话。② Gateway 启动提速与进度可见：预启动步骤并行化（数据库就绪 + 系统守护清理同时跑）、干净退出后重启跳过 5s 崩溃冷却、健康探测前 5s 快轮询；新增启动进度推送（清理残留→准备数据库→检查端口→启动内核→等待就绪→连接），对话页信息横幅与左轨状态项实时展示步骤/进度条/重试次数，晚加载窗口自动补齐当前进度。③ 连接状态三态稳定化：启动窗口内 WS 被拒不再把「启动中」闪成「重连中」（进度事件是启动活性的权威信号），持续失败 10s 才落错误态且不再被退避重连无限打回抖动，启动静默超 45s 自动给出手动重试入口；修复进度快照残留——状态机离开 starting 即清快照、gateway:state 仅启动窗口携带进度，不再出现「启动中 + 就绪 100%」的矛盾卡片。④ 任务页适配 2026.9.7 内核重建：运行记录改走 cron.runs 全量拉取（状态/耗时/任务名归一化），定时任务 tab 保留并补能力门控，cron 广播事件驱动刷新（仅任务页打开时，含在途补跑）。⑤ 动效与视觉：移除流式思考的上下滚动跑马灯，新增视图切换/会话面板/弹层/卡片渐入等过渡（全部 transform/opacity 实现 + prefers-reduced-motion 降级）；修复设置导航激活态与微信徽标对比度。⑥ 对话体验：断连时消息乐观入队（连回自动发送）+ 待发送提示、历史骨架屏、原始英文错误全面本地化。经全量测试（vitest / node 308 / chat-ui 872 / scripts 132）与四路并行代码审查（发现项全部修复）。
notes.en: Eight-item fix and polish batch: store install failure fix, faster Gateway startup with live progress, Tasks page rebuilt for the new kernel, plus app-wide animation and stability improvements. (1) Skill/plugin store installs no longer fail with "does not recognize option": the ack flag now matches kernel 2026.9.7 (--acknowledge-install-policy-warning) with a graceful downgrade chain (new flag → legacy flag → none) for older kernels — stripping the flag outright would fail against install-policy prompts. Plugin update check timeout raised 90s → 180s, with an automatic ClawHub HTTP fallback when the CLI times out and the list cache is warm (versions now come from the same cache, no second CLI spawn); failures are classified into human-readable timeout/network/config messages. (2) Faster, visible Gateway startup: pre-start steps run in parallel (DB readiness + daemon cleanup), clean restarts skip the 5s crash cooldown, and health polling starts fast; a new startup progress feed (cleanup → database → port → spawn → health → connect) drives a live banner and rail status card with steps, progress bar, and retry count, backfilled for late-loading windows. (3) Connection state stabilization: WS rejections during startup no longer flicker "starting" into "reconnecting" (progress events are the authoritative liveness signal); the failure state is stable instead of oscillating under backoff reconnects, and a 45s startup silence escalates to a manual retry entry; fixed stale progress snapshots — the state machine clears them when leaving "starting" and gateway:state only carries progress during startup, eliminating the contradictory "starting + ready 100%" card. (4) Tasks page rebuilt for kernel 2026.9.7: run history now reads from cron.runs (normalized status/duration/job names), the scheduled-jobs tab gains capability gating, and cron broadcast events drive refreshes (only while the Tasks view is open, with in-flight coalescing). (5) Motion and visuals: removed the scrolling thinking marquee; added view-switch, panel, popover, and card stagger transitions (all transform/opacity with prefers-reduced-motion fallbacks); fixed contrast on the active settings nav and Weixin badge. (6) Chat experience: messages queue optimistically while disconnected (auto-sent on reconnect) with a pending hint, history skeleton screens, and fully localized error text. Verified by the full test suite (vitest / node 308 / chat-ui 872 / scripts 132) and a four-lane parallel code review with all findings fixed.

notes.zh: 九项修复批次：任务页内核门控 + 插件白名单同步 + 渠道 bundled 判定统一 + 技能/插件预加载与反馈 + 模型页抽屉化 + WebBridge 钉定永久化。① 「任务」页不再报 unknown method: tasks.list——2026.9.7 内核已移除 tasks.* RPC 与 task 事件，前端改为按 hello 能力面（features.methods/events）门控：无接口时显示说明性空态并停止 30s 无效轮询，旧内核不受影响；同步新增内核 RPC 面审计脚本与 CI 基线（scripts/kernel-method-audit，方法表 483 项/事件 60 项逐项比对，未登记 gap 直接失败）。② 插件更新检查不再裸漏「Command failed」原文：dry-run 补 install-policy ack 参数、失败按 blocked/配置校验/网络/通用分档为人话文案，内核无信号死亡且列表缓存已热时自动走 HTTP 回退重查；根治「已启用但不在 plugins.allow 白名单被内核静默禁用」——新增统一启用通道（主进程一次原子写 entries.enabled + allow 同步）与启动期全量对齐，市场安装/配置恢复路径同样并入。③ 技能与插件预加载：启动后错峰预热插件列表（冷启 ~15s）与技能商店首屏缓存，连接后 idle 预取已装技能状态，首开各页免冷启等待；补齐技能安装/卸载与插件开关的成功反馈，开关后后台回拉校验内核实际状态（不阻塞开关）。④ 性能与流畅度：端口释放等待 100ms 起步指数退避（快乐路径不再白等 500ms）、模型页 agents.list 从渲染期副作用移到 tab 激活、分组/回退/默认模型按 config 快照记忆化、模型卡片 repeat() 键控、重置清态补全。⑤「远程控制」企业微信误报「插件组件缺失」根治：bundled 判定从单一目录改为四根可解析（内核 bundled 扩展 / mirror / 用户扩展目录 / npm projects 扫描），运行态查询前对 wecom 做限流 reconcile 自愈；新增飞书渠道 bundled 检查与横幅；微信/QQ/飞书/企业微信/钉钉五渠道补单测。⑥ 模型配置页「编辑模型能力」从卡片行内改为右侧抽屉（fixed + 遮罩 + Esc/点外关闭），消除卡片行被撑高留下的整片灰色空白；编辑器组件化后按键只重渲染编辑器自身。⑦ WebBridge「校验未通过（上游已更新）」永久化：钉定清单 schema v2 支持每文件多枚历史哈希（保留最近 5），校验接受内嵌∪远程并集；新增应用内「刷新钉定」（绕 24h 缓存强制拉取，stale 缓存不再误报成功）与 GitHub workflow 自动轮转 resources/webbridge-pins.json，信任模型保持 sha256 fail-closed。经全量测试（vitest 258 / node 302 / chat-ui 855 / scripts 129）与 CodeReview 代理逐项评审（Critical/Important 问题全部修复）。
notes.en: Nine-item fix batch: tasks-page kernel gating, plugin allow-list sync, unified channel bundled detection, skills/plugins preloading with better feedback, model-page drawer, and a permanent WebBridge pin fix. (1) The Tasks page no longer errors with 'unknown method: tasks.list' - kernel 2026.9.7 removed the tasks.* RPCs and the task event, so the UI now gates on the hello capability surface (features.methods/events): without the API it renders an explanatory empty state and stops the pointless 30s polling, while older kernels keep working; a new kernel RPC-surface audit script plus CI baseline (scripts/kernel-method-audit: 483 methods / 60 events diffed against repo usage; unregistered gaps fail the build) guards future kernel bumps. (2) Plugin update checks no longer leak raw 'Command failed' text: dry-run now passes the install-policy ack flag, failures are classified into human-readable reasons (blocked / invalid config / network / generic), and a network death with a warm list cache triggers the HTTP re-check fallback; the 'enabled but silently disabled because the id is missing from plugins.allow' bug is root-fixed with a unified enable path (one atomic main-process write of entries.enabled plus allow sync), a startup-wide reconciliation, and allow syncing on market installs and config restores. (3) Skills and plugins are preloaded: after startup the plugin list (cold start ~15s) and the skill-store first page are warmed into their caches off the critical path, and installed-skill status is prefetched on idle after connect, so first opens no longer pay cold-start latency; skill install/uninstall and plugin toggle now show success toasts, and toggles verify the kernel-side state in the background without blocking the switch. (4) Performance and smoothness: port-release waits back off exponentially from 100ms (no more fixed 500ms on the happy path), the model page's agents.list call moved from a render-time side effect to tab activation, provider grouping/fallbacks/default model are memoized per config snapshot, model cards re-render through keyed repeat(), and state-reset paths clear all module-level caches. (5) The WeCom false 'plugin components missing' banner is root-fixed: bundled detection now resolves four roots (kernel-bundled extensions / mirror / user extensions dir / npm-projects scan), and the runtime-state query performs a throttled reconcile first for self-healing; Feishu gains a bundled check and banner; unit tests cover all five channels (WeChat, QQ, Feishu, WeCom, DingTalk) including the four-root presence checks and message mapping. (6) The model 'Edit capabilities' editor moved from inside the card row into a right-side drawer (fixed, mask, Esc/click-outside to close), eliminating the large gray gap the inline panel left behind; the editor is now a component so keystrokes re-render only the editor itself. (7) WebBridge 'verification failed (upstream updated)' is permanently addressed: the pins manifest schema v2 keeps up to 5 historical hashes per file and verification accepts the union of embedded and remote pins; a new in-app 'Refresh pins' action force-fetches the manifest (stale-cache fallbacks no longer report success), and a GitHub workflow rotates resources/webbridge-pins.json automatically; the trust model stays sha256 fail-closed. Verified by the full suite (vitest 258 / node 302 / chat-ui 855 / scripts 129) and a line-by-line CodeReview agent pass (all Critical/Important findings fixed).

notes.zh: Windows 聊天修复批次（v2026.1004.0 紧随修复）：2026.9.7 内核在 Windows 上使每条消息都以「This turn ended before a reply: WorkerTaskError: DataCloneError」失败——根因是内核 Windows 专属的 env Proxy（大小写不敏感访问包装）经会话读取请求泄漏进 worker 线程的 postMessage，structured clone 拒绝 Proxy 对象（原版 npm 包零改动同样复现，属上游缺陷）。已在打包补丁链热修：worker 池派发前把输入树中的 Proxy 快照为纯对象（worker 侧自带大小写不敏感 env 查询，语义不变），并加打包期 asar 断言防回退；真机验证修复前 100% 失败、修复后完整问答跑通。本版也包含 2026.1004.0 的全部内容（内核 2026.9.7 适配、会话「分支」UI、升级死锁自愈等），详见该版本说明。
notes.en: Windows chat hotfix (released right after v2026.1004.0): with kernel 2026.9.7 on Windows, every message ended with "This turn ended before a reply: WorkerTaskError: DataCloneError" - the kernel's Windows-only env Proxy (its case-insensitive env-access wrapper) leaked through a session-read request into a worker-thread postMessage, and structured clone rejects Proxy objects (reproduced with the pristine npm package, so this is an upstream defect). Fixed in the packaging patch chain: the worker pool now snapshots any Proxy in the task input to a plain object before dispatch (the worker performs its own case-insensitive env lookups, so semantics are unchanged), with a build-time asar assertion to prevent regressions; on the real machine the failure was 100% before the fix and full end-to-end conversations pass after it. This release also contains everything from 2026.1004.0 (kernel 2026.9.7 adaptation, the Branches UI, the upgrade-deadlock self-heal, and more) - see that entry for details.

notes.zh: 内核升级批次：openclaw 2026.9.3 → 2026.9.7 + 会话「分支」体系 UI + 打包补丁链适配 + 升级死锁修复。① 内核 2026.9.7 取证与适配：Node engines 与 dist 结构形态不变；RPC 面一减一增——旧 sessions.compaction.{list,restore,branch} 被内核移除，替代为树模型 sessions.branches.list/switch + sessions.rewind/fork（transcript 为一棵树，可见历史=active path），@openclaw/fs-safe 0.8.5→0.21.1（pinned-open 的 realPath 声明改形，打包补丁已适配双形态，身份观测点两版逐字节同形）；渠道插件 schema 收紧（qqbot 不再随内核分发、telegram 令牌字段 token→botToken），asar 启动冒烟夹具随之修正并真机验证通过，取证详见 docs/kernel-recon/2026.9.7-diff.md。② 会话「分支」UI（新功能，替代旧回放点面板）：输入框新增「分支」按钮，列出当前会话全部分支（末条消息预览 / 消息数 / 时间 / 当前标记），一键切换到其他分支找回被收起的对话；用户消息气泡悬停新增两个入口——「回退编辑」把该消息及其之后移出当前视图（内容保留为分支可随时切回，非破坏），消息文本与图片自动回填输入框修改后重发，「分叉新会话」把这段对话复制成全新会话继续推进（输入框预填该消息内容）；agent 工作中时操作会被内核拒绝并给出明确提示；跨会话防误操作（分支列表归属校验）与并发防重入齐备。③ 升级死锁修复（存量用户首启必踩）：9.7 内核要求 agent 数据库 schema 升级（userVersion 19→24），不满足即拒绝启动，而迁移入口 doctor 的租约准入会把「pid 被系统进程复用」的陈旧租约误判为占用（实测 3 周前的死租约永久阻塞迁移）——现于网关启动前自动检测并完成迁移（清失效租约 → doctor --fix --non-interactive → 复检），升级后首启无感自愈。④ 稳定内核渠道 stable 推进 2026.9.3 → 2026.9.7（证据链：真实安装树补丁全命中 + gateway.asar 32164 文件校验 + asar 真实启动冒烟含渠道 doctor-contract 加载链）。⑤ 优化：rail 活跃任务角标按 tasks 数组引用记忆化（高频渲染不再每帧新建数组）；用户消息气泡支持复制为 Markdown（与助手气泡同款悬浮交互）。经全量测试（vitest 252 / node 276 / chat-ui 849 / scripts 124）与内核真实安装 + asar 启动冒烟 + 真机迁移验证。
notes.en: Kernel-upgrade batch: openclaw 2026.9.3 → 2026.9.7 + a new session "Branches" UI + packaging patch-chain adaptation + an upgrade-deadlock fix. (1) Kernel 2026.9.7 recon and adaptation: Node engines and dist structure are unchanged; the RPC surface swaps one family for another - the old sessions.compaction.{list,restore,branch} calls were removed upstream and replaced by a tree model (sessions.branches.list/switch + sessions.rewind/fork, where the transcript is a tree and visible history is the active path), and @openclaw/fs-safe jumped 0.8.5 → 0.21.1 (pinned-open's realPath declaration changed shape; the packaging patch now supports both forms byte-identically at the identity observation points). Channel plugin schemas tightened (qqbot no longer ships with the kernel; telegram's token field became botToken) - the asar boot smoke fixture was updated accordingly and verified on the real kernel; see docs/kernel-recon/2026.9.7-diff.md. (2) Session "Branches" UI (new, replaces the old rewind-point panel): a Branches button next to the composer lists every branch of the current session (last-message preview / message count / time / current badge) with one-click switching to recover collapsed conversations; user bubbles gain two hover entries - "Rewind & edit" moves this message and everything after it out of the current view (kept as a branch you can switch back to, non-destructive) and puts its text and images back into the composer for editing, and "Fork into new session" copies the conversation up to this message into a brand-new session (composer pre-filled). While the agent is working the kernel refuses the actions with a clear error; cross-session misuse guards and single-flight busy protection are in place. (3) Upgrade-deadlock fix (every existing user hits this on first launch): the 9.7 kernel requires an agent-database schema upgrade (userVersion 19 → 24) and refuses to start otherwise, while the migration entry point (doctor) misreads stale lease rows whose pids were reused by system processes as "database in use" (verified live: a 3-week-old dead lease permanently blocked migration) - the app now detects and completes the migration automatically before starting the gateway (purge dead leases → doctor --fix --non-interactive → re-verify), so the first launch after upgrading self-heals silently. (4) The curated stable kernel channel advances 2026.9.3 → 2026.9.7 (evidence: real-install patch hits, gateway.asar 32,164-file verification, and a real asar-mode boot smoke including the channel doctor-contract chain). (5) Optimizations: the rail's active-task badge is memoized on the tasks array reference (no more per-frame filter allocations), and user bubbles now support copy-as-Markdown like assistant bubbles. Verified by the full suite (vitest 252 / node 276 / chat-ui 849 / scripts 124) plus a real kernel install, asar boot smoke, and live migration.

notes.zh: 对话体验专项批次：流式输出重复根治 + MEDIA: 文件标记流式渲染 + 思考折叠过渡动画 + 全链路对话审查修复（30+ 项）。① 流式重复六因根治：终态帧丢失后预对齐/orphan 探测补回复检查（历史与流式气泡不再并存双份，渲染层另有同文抑制兜底）；gateway 序列号去重（重放帧不再二次追加）且重连后按连接重置；replace 重生成越过工具边界时作废旧冻结段；正文流开始时清理解说气泡（不再双轨同文）；自检连续失配三帧强制以快照收敛（不再盲追加）；orphan/在途收养显式清残留并拒收已落盘回复。② MEDIA:文件路径 标记在流式期间即渲染为图片/文件卡片（此前仅终态后渲染；markdown 流式按行推进 + stable 段接入媒体管线），兼容小写/全角冒号，无扩展名回退为文件卡片。③ 托管图片鉴权修复（实测根因）：HTTP 媒体端点只接受网关共享 token、拒绝设备 token（401），而旧实现优先发设备 token 且失败后永不回退——所有内核生成的图片（含历史记录）退化为「⚠ 文件名」占位。现按候选序列尝试（共享 token 优先 → 设备 token 兜底），命中记忆避免重复撞 401，失败带状态码告警；失败占位可点击重试（无需整页刷新）。④ 思考与工具折叠改为真实高度过渡动画（Chromium interpolate-size），live→完成切换渐显衔接，reduced-motion 下退化瞬变；思考区用户上滚后不再被强行拽回底部。⑤ 对话审查修复：orphan 快照不再被 status 帧误清；回复检查锚定 user 回声（上一轮 1s 内容差不再误判本轮）；队列失败回队与错误卡重发不再双份发送；/new 重置标记只被本 run 终态消费（旧对话残留修复）；重连后序列号重置（服务端重编号不再静默丢事件）；工具结果合并双索引同步摘除（孤儿结果不再覆盖已渲染输出）；并发历史加载按代际取最新（加载态不再互踩）；中止按钮有在途态且各清态点一致清零；工具卡展开后输出实时更新（不再定格）；代码围栏内不再按行误切 markdown；命令建议过期不再劫持 Enter；屏幕阅读器不再逐 token 播报流式文本；路径链接键盘可达；8 处硬编码英文走 i18n；文件变更同轮先读后建显示「新增」；信封头剥离不再误伤用户手打时间戳。⑥ 回归修复：中途落盘回复不再清活跃 run（inFlightRun 权威闸门 + 清态前 orphan 快照兜底），收养判定按 startedAt 分档（时间戳兜底仅缺 startedAt 时启用），回声锚定 +1s 宽限；同文抑制仅在纯正文场景生效（思考/解说活跃时保留流式区）。经全量测试（chat-ui 837 / node / vitest / scripts 123）与发版四步 CDP 冒烟验证。
notes.en: Conversation-experience batch: streaming-duplication root-cause fixes + streaming MEDIA: marker rendering + thinking-collapse transitions + a full chat-pipeline audit (30+ fixes). (1) Six streaming-duplication causes eliminated: the pre-align/orphan history probes now check for a persisted reply (history and the live bubble no longer render the same text twice, with a render-layer same-text guard as a second net); gateway frames are deduplicated by sequence number (replayed frames no longer append twice) and the counter resets per connection; replace frames that regenerate across a tool boundary now invalidate the stale frozen segment; narration bubbles clear once body text starts (no more dual-track duplicates); three consecutive cross-check mismatches force a snapshot resync (no more blind appending); orphan/in-flight adoption clears residue and refuses runs whose reply already landed in history. (2) MEDIA:path markers now render as image/file cards during streaming (previously only after the run ended; streaming markdown now advances line-by-line and the stable segment runs the media pipeline), accept lowercase/full-width-colon forms, and fall back to a file card when no known extension is present. (3) Managed-image auth fixed (root cause verified live): the gateway HTTP media endpoint accepts only the shared gateway token and rejects device tokens with 401, while the old implementation sent the device token first and never fell back - every kernel-generated image (including history) degraded to a 'warning + filename' placeholder. Fetches now try an ordered candidate list (shared token first, device token as fallback), remember which credential works to avoid repeated 401s, log the failure status, and the failed placeholder is click-to-retry (no full reload needed). (4) Thinking and tool collapses use real height transitions (Chromium interpolate-size) with a fade-in handoff from the live block, degrading to instant under reduced-motion; the live thinking pane no longer yanks the user back to the bottom while scrolled up. (5) Audit fixes: orphan snapshots are no longer cleared by status frames; reply detection anchors to the user echo (last turn's reply within the 1s tolerance no longer impersonates this run); queue re-queue on failure and error-card resend no longer double-send; /new reset markers are consumed only by the owning run's terminal event (stale-conversation residue fixed); sequence numbers reset on reconnect (server-renumbered streams no longer silently dropped); tool-result merging removes slots from both indexes (orphan results no longer overwrite rendered output); concurrent history loads are generation-gated (loading state no longer flickers off early); the Stop button gains a pending state with consistent clearing at every reset point; expanded tool cards keep updating (no more frozen snapshots); markdown no longer splits lines inside unclosed code fences; stale command suggestions no longer hijack Enter; screen readers no longer announce every streamed token; path links are keyboard-reachable; 8 hardcoded English strings moved to i18n; same-turn read-then-create shows as added; envelope-header stripping no longer eats hand-typed timestamps. (6) Regression fixes: mid-run persisted replies no longer clear a live run (inFlightRun authoritative gate + orphan-snapshot fallback before clearing), adoption is tiered by kernel startedAt (timestamp fallback only when startedAt is absent), echo anchoring gains a +1s slack, and same-text suppression only applies to pure-body streaming (thinking/narration panes stay visible). Verified by the full test suite (chat-ui 837 / node / vitest / scripts 123) and the four-step CDP release smoke.

notes.zh: 全项目全方位代码审查修复批次（八分区并行子智能体审计，53 项确认发现全部落地）+ 测试基建重构。① Bug 修复：UI 截图 QA 的跨组件重叠硬门禁失效修复（数组与数字比较恒 false，重叠缺陷永远无法判红发版闸门）；kimi-auth-proxy 生命周期三修——OS 动态端口兜底路径补运行期 error 监听（第二次错误不再崩主进程）、并发启动去重（旧代理实例不再泄漏成永远关不掉的活体代理）、excludePort 真正接线避让 gateway 端口；gateway 启动竞态修复（健康确认后复查状态，用户主动停止不再被误判崩溃并自动拉起；health 超时不再静默停摆，与启动期退出恢复语义对齐）；OAuth 设备授权路径补 expires_in NaN 守卫（不再每 60s 空转刷新）；配置迁移反向路径不再静默丢弃 updatePlan 设置；git cwd 不存在时不再误报「请安装 Git」（独立 not-found 错误码）；WebBridge pins 环境变量覆盖强制 https；WebBridge 换装失败不再误报为下载失败（独立 swap-failed 文案）。② 前端修复：app 组件卸载时 gateway client 与定时器正确停止（重挂载不再泄漏 WebSocket 连接与轮询）；重连时 sessions/tasks 双份全量 RPC 消重；模型列表加载失败保留旧值（瞬断不再清空选择器）；附件读取窗口切会话不再把 last-active 写回旧会话；主题快速连切不再产生未处理 rejection；gateway 握手前置 await 失败会触发重连（socket 不再半死）；ticker 可见性恢复重入守卫；工具详情路径缩短支持 Windows（C:\Users\xxx → ~）；cron 周字段 7（周日）人性化显示；输入框高度指纹加换行计数（等长粘贴不再卡高度）；会话名过长优雅省略（修复 inline-flex 下省略号失效的硬切断）；空状态文案均衡折行（不再单字坠行）。③ 性能：UI 重叠扫描 O(n²) 重复可见矩形计算改缓存（设置页不再卡 renderer 数秒）；更新状态快照不再每次发布都同步读盘；每次重连少 2 次全量 RPC。④ 供应链：插件缓存损坏重下路径补齐 sha256 钉定校验（守卫不再在该路径失效）。⑤ 测试基建：四个 CDP 冒烟脚本抽公共 cdp-harness（消除 ~150 行重复），固定 sleep 改就绪轮询；UI 截图 QA 新增文本截断/横向溢出扫描、WCAG 对比度启发式、机器可读 report.json、dark 主题全视图覆盖；run-node-tests 的 vitest 排除清单改为从 vitest.config.ts 自动派生（消除双份清单漂移）；measure-startup 不再按映像名误杀用户实例。⑥ 死代码与注释：清理无调用方的 tray setTooltip / icons.icon() / interactiveRowAttrs / 未使用 import 等 8 处，修正 12 处过期或误导性注释（含脱敏正则误伤 author 字段）。经全量测试（chat-ui 756 / node 276 / vitest / scripts 123）与发版四步 CDP 冒烟验证。
notes.en: Project-wide audit-and-fix release (eight-partition parallel subagent review; all 53 confirmed findings addressed) plus test-infrastructure overhaul. (1) Bug fixes: the UI screenshot QA cross-component overlap hard gate was dead (array compared against a number, always false - overlap defects could never fail the release gate); kimi-auth-proxy lifecycle triple fix - the OS-assigned-port fallback now removes the one-shot error listener and attaches a runtime logger (a second runtime error no longer crashes the main process), concurrent starts are deduplicated via an inflight promise (the losing proxy instance no longer leaks as an unkillable live proxy holding a real token), and excludePort is finally wired so the proxy avoids the gateway port; gateway start races fixed (state re-checked after the health probe, so a user-initiated stop is no longer misread as a crash and auto-restarted; a health-timeout stop now fires the crash hook, aligning recovery semantics with startup exits); the OAuth device-grant path gains the same expires_in NaN guard as the refresh path (no more 60s refresh hammering); the reverse plan-tool migration no longer silently drops updatePlan when tools.experimental is scalar; a missing git cwd no longer reports 'please install Git' (new not-found error code); WebBridge pins env overrides are forced to https; WebBridge swap failures get their own swap-failed reason instead of being mislabeled download failures. (2) Renderer fixes: the app element now stops the gateway client and ticker on disconnect (remount no longer leaks WebSocket connections and polling); reconnects no longer fire duplicate full sessions/tasks RPCs; a failed model-list load keeps the previous value (transient failures no longer blank the picker); switching sessions during attachment reads no longer writes last-active back to the old session; rapid theme toggles no longer produce unhandled rejections; gateway handshake pre-flight failures now close the socket and trigger reconnect (no more half-dead sockets); the ticker guards against visibility-resume reentry; tool-detail path shortening now handles Windows homes (C:\Users\xxx -> ~); cron day-of-week 7 displays as Sunday; the textarea auto-height fingerprint counts newlines (equal-length pastes no longer freeze height); long session names ellipsize gracefully (inline-flex was defeating text-overflow); empty-state text wraps balanced. (3) Performance: the overlap scan caches visible rects instead of recomputing them per pair (settings pages no longer block the renderer for seconds); update-state snapshots no longer read the snooze file synchronously on every publish; two fewer full RPCs per reconnect. (4) Supply chain: the corrupted-cache re-download path now re-verifies the plugin sha256 pin. (5) Test infrastructure: the four CDP smoke scripts share a new cdp-harness (~150 lines of duplication removed) with readiness polling instead of fixed sleeps; the UI screenshot QA adds text-clipping/horizontal-overflow scans, a WCAG contrast heuristic, a machine-readable report.json, and full dark-theme view coverage; run-node-tests derives the vitest exclusion list from vitest.config.ts (no more dual-list drift); measure-startup kills only its own process tree. (6) Dead code and comments: removed 8 unused exports/imports (tray setTooltip, icons.icon(), interactiveRowAttrs, and more) and corrected 12 stale or misleading comments (including a redaction regex that mangled author fields). Verified by the full test suite (chat-ui 756 / node 276 / vitest / scripts 123) and the four-step CDP release smoke.

notes.zh: 紧急修复 + 真实使用体验走查改进批次。① P0 热修：kimi-coding/kimi-for-coding 全部请求报 authentication failed (HTTP 403) 修复——2026.922.0 的浏览器跨站防护把「带 sec-fetch-* 头」一律当浏览器拒绝，但 Node 24 内置 undici fetch 会按规范自动附带 sec-fetch-mode: cors，导致 gateway 内核的全部模型请求被本地鉴权代理 403 拦截（设置页显示登录成功、聊天却永远失败）；现只对浏览器专属头（sec-fetch-site/sec-fetch-dest、非 cors 的 sec-fetch-mode）拒绝，且 403 响应体写明拒绝原因便于排查。② 定时任务调度显示中文化与人性化：原「Cron 0 3 * * *」裸表达式改为「每天 03:00」「每周一 09:30」「每 5 分钟」，every 间隔显示「每 3 小时/每 7 天」，英文界面同步（Daily/Weekly/Every/Once），认不出的表达式保留原文。③ 工作空间文件列表不再显示 node_modules（展开即数千项的纯噪音）。④ 设置-远程控制页描述文案修正（去掉了列表中并不存在的 Kimi 渠道）。本次改进来自 kimi-cu 真实用户场景模拟走查（聊天/任务/工作空间/扩展/设置全页面）。经全量测试（chat-ui 756 / 含新增 presenter 调度显示 14 断言）与类型检查验证。
notes.en: Hotfix plus real-usage walkthrough improvements. (1) P0: every kimi-coding/kimi-for-coding request failed with authentication failed (HTTP 403) - the 2026.922.0 browser cross-site guard rejected any request carrying sec-fetch-* headers, but Node 24's built-in undici fetch automatically attaches sec-fetch-mode: cors per spec, so the gateway kernel's model requests were all 403'd by the local auth proxy (settings showed login OK while chat always failed); now only browser-only headers (sec-fetch-site/sec-fetch-dest, or sec-fetch-mode with non-cors values) are rejected, and 403 bodies state the rejection reason for diagnosability. (2) Cron schedule display localized and humanized: raw 'Cron 0 3 * * *' becomes 'Daily 03:00' / 'Weekly Mon 09:30' / 'Every 5 min' (Chinese equivalents in zh UI), 'every' intervals read naturally, unrecognized expressions keep the raw form. (3) The workspace file list no longer shows node_modules (thousands of noise entries). (4) Settings > Remote Control description no longer lists a Kimi channel that does not exist in the list. All improvements stem from a kimi-cu simulated real-user walkthrough across chat, tasks, workspace, extensions, and settings. Verified by the full test suite (chat-ui 756, including 14 new schedule-display assertions) and type checks.

notes.zh: 全项目深审修复批次（七分区并行子智能体审计 + 四批修复，共 61 项确认问题全部落地）。① 安全：kimi-auth-proxy 增加浏览器跨站与 DNS rebinding 防护（拒绝带 sec-fetch/Origin 的请求 + Host 白名单 + 405 OPTIONS）——此前任意恶意网页可借本地代理携带真实 OAuth token 调用上游消耗额度；OAuth 刷新竞态修复（single-flight 并发去重 + invalid_grant 删除前校验 refresh_token 未被轮换，不再误删对手方刚写入的新 token；缺 expires_in 兜底 3600s，不再每 60s 空转刷新）；file:read-base64 增加凭据路径黑名单（~/.openclaw/credentials、openclaw.json、cryoclaw.config.json、*.log、~/.ssh/.aws/.gnupg）；「打开网页版」改一次性 60s handoff code 跳板，浏览器 URL 不再携带长期 gateway token；BrowserWindow 显式 sandbox:true；gateway:ready 广播按可信窗口过滤。② 数据保护：配置损坏保险丝不再把文件 rename 走（此前会绕过全部恢复链路、last-known-good 快照被空配置污染）；readUserConfig 区分「文件不存在」与「瞬时锁」错误（杀软锁文件时不再以空对象整文件覆盖蒸发配置）；备份列表 TOCTOU 容错且查询不再带删除副作用；写前快照比对守卫关闭主进程整文件写与 gateway 内核 config.patch 之间的丢更新窗口；备份去重（内容相同/60s 内跳过），10 个回退槽位不再被连写瞬间挤满。③ 进程生命周期：gateway 启停竞态修复（预启动后复查状态 + 退出路径等待在途操作），告别退出后残留孤儿进程；崩溃重启与启动重试双链并发修复（监督式启动标记），崩溃预算不再被同一故障双倍消耗、恢复入口不再重复弹窗；Windows 强制停止失败重试并醒目告警残留。④ 更新与内核：WebBridge 换装失败自动恢复 daemon（不再静默死亡到下次启动）；内核换装写 journal 崩溃成对自愈（新 asar 配旧 unpacked 的错配消除）、更新锁带 startedAt 超时（PID 复用不再永久锁死升级）、回退残留 .rbk- 清理；后台更新 available 态不再被周期复查打断（弹窗内容闪烁消除）；quitAndInstall 被拦截不再永久卡死（will-quit 确认 + 30s 兜底复位）。⑤ 前端：路径链接化实体双重转义修复（含 & 路径不再截断/损坏）；/new 后断连丢 final 帧的旧历史残留修复（重连按重置标记强制替换）；非法 gatewayUrl 不再中断启动初始化（try/catch + ws/wss 白名单）；board iframe 移除 allow-same-origin（沙箱失效组合消除）；预对齐指数退避（长思考 run 不再每 30s 全量拉历史）；questionPrompts 终态回收 + 硬上限（长跑不再累积）；插件视图重置使在途市场请求失效。⑥ 构建与脚本：asar 模式补注入插件产物校验（win-arm64 缺全部 provider 插件不再绿灯出包）；installer.nsh 卸载器去掉 /T（级联自杀隐患消除）；插件安装注入 npm 镜像 registry 与捆绑 runtime PATH（弱网/引擎校验失败修复）；run-node-tests 递归收集（子目录测试不再静默不跑）；zip 空文件不再被错解成目录；dist-all-parallel 的 win 任务注入签名环境。⑦ 其他：CLI .cmd wrapper 加 chcp 65001（中文用户名/路径下 CLI 修复）；POSIX 不再为不存在的 rc 文件造文件（bash 登录不再遮蔽用户 ~/.profile）；插件 manifest 读取恢复三态错误语义（杀软扫描不再误删插件配置）；记忆梦境删除改字符区间定位（同日期不再删错条目）；企业微信验证 WS 帧状态机（分片/ping 不再误判失败）；微信账号索引原子写；workspace 路径 containment 大小写归一；dev-isolated 凭据 gitignore 按行精确判定。经全量测试（1390 用例：chat-ui 754 / node 275 / vitest 243 / scripts 118）与类型检查验证。
notes.en: Project-wide audit-and-fix release (seven-partition parallel subagent audit plus four fix batches; all 61 confirmed findings addressed). (1) Security: the kimi-auth-proxy now rejects browser-originated requests (sec-fetch/Origin headers), enforces a Host allowlist, and answers OPTIONS with 405 - previously any malicious web page could drive the local proxy to spend the user's real OAuth token upstream; OAuth refresh races fixed (single-flight dedup, and invalid_grant now re-checks the refresh_token before deleting so a freshly rotated token is never removed; missing expires_in falls back to 3600s instead of hammering the refresh endpoint every 60s); file:read-base64 gains a credential-path denylist (~/.openclaw/credentials, openclaw.json, cryoclaw.config.json, *.log, ~/.ssh/.aws/.gnupg); Open Web UI now opens through a one-time 60s handoff code, so the long-lived gateway token never lands in browser URLs; BrowserWindow sets sandbox:true explicitly; gateway:ready broadcasts are filtered to trusted windows. (2) Data protection: the corrupt-config fuse no longer renames the file away (which used to bypass every recovery path and poison the last-known-good snapshot); readUserConfig distinguishes a missing file from a transient lock (antivirus-lock reads no longer return an empty object that overwrote and evaporated the config); backup listing tolerates TOCTOU and no longer deletes as a side effect of a query; a write-time snapshot guard closes the lost-update window between main-process whole-file writes and the gateway kernel's config.patch; backups are de-duplicated (identical content or within 60s), so the ten rollback slots are no longer churned by rapid consecutive writes. (3) Process lifecycle: the gateway start/stop race is fixed (state re-checked after pre-start, exit paths await in-flight operations), ending orphaned processes after quit; a supervised-start marker stops the crash-restart and startup-retry loops from double-charging the crash budget or double-prompting recovery; Windows force-stop retries once and loudly reports a residual process. (4) Updates and kernel: a failed WebBridge swap now restarts the daemon instead of dying silently until the next launch; kernel swaps write a journal for paired crash self-healing (no more new-asar-with-old-unpacked mixups), the update lock carries a startedAt timeout (PID reuse no longer wedges upgrades forever), and .rbk- rollback debris is cleaned; periodic re-checks no longer interrupt the available state (dialog flicker gone); quitAndInstall can no longer wedge forever when app.quit() is intercepted (will-quit confirmation plus a 30s fallback reset). (5) Frontend: entity double-escaping in path linkification fixed (paths containing & no longer truncate or corrupt); stale-history residue after /new when the final frame is lost during a disconnect is fixed (reconnects force-replace when a reset is pending); a malformed gatewayUrl no longer aborts startup (try/catch plus a ws/wss allowlist); the board iframe drops allow-same-origin (broken-sandbox combo removed); pre-align now backs off exponentially (long thinking runs no longer pull full history every 30s); terminal question prompts are reaped with a hard cap; leaving the plugin view invalidates in-flight market requests. (6) Build and scripts: asar builds now verify injected plugin artifacts (win-arm64 can no longer ship green with every provider plugin missing); installer.nsh drops /T from the uninstaller (cascade-suicide hazard removed); plugin installs get the npm mirror registry and bundled-runtime PATH (weak-network and engine-check failures fixed); run-node-tests collects recursively (subdirectory tests no longer silently skipped); extensionless empty zip entries are no longer extracted as directories; dist-all-parallel passes signing env to the Windows job. (7) Everything else: CLI .cmd wrappers set chcp 65001 (fixes non-ASCII user names/paths); POSIX no longer creates missing rc files (bash login no longer shadows ~/.profile); plugin manifest reads restore their three-state error semantics (antivirus scans no longer mis-disable plugin configs); dream-entry removal now slices by character range (same-date entries are no longer deleted wrongly); WeCom verification uses a proper WebSocket frame state machine (fragmentation/ping no longer misreport failure); the WeChat account index is written atomically; workspace containment normalizes case; dev-isolated checks gitignore lines exactly. Verified by the full test suite (1390 cases: chat-ui 754 / node 275 / vitest 243 / scripts 118) and type checks.

notes.zh: 设计系统统一重设计 + 全项目双批次深审。① 设计系统统一（B1–B5）：自定义组件前缀全面统一 oc-（rail/会话面板/聊天流/历史渲染/拖宽分隔条五组件改名，355 处 BEM 类同步）；新增布局令牌——内容列两档 --content-form 720px / --content-wide 1200px、页边距 --page-gutter、z-index 五档层级契约，titlebar/横幅/对话框/灯箱/提示的裸值全部令牌化；全局原语落地（icon-btn 三尺寸 + danger 变体、setting-row 设置行、empty-state 空态）并收编 40+ 处重复图标按钮实现；任务页头部重构（筛选器下沉工具栏、自动刷新与刷新归页头右侧）、扩展页砍掉重复三级导航并解除 720px 内容帽、外观页设置行化、工作区空态统一、对话空态 starter 卡配图标、当前态 2px 指示条三处统一。② 三轮样式合规审查：清理 31 处过期 CSS fallback（含 --danger 死链与语义色错值导致的真实渲染偏差）、8 份重复 spin 动画统一为全局 oc-spin、静态内联样式 42→13 处（其余为动态计算值合法保留；新增 oc-text-*/oc-flex-1/oc-hidden 原子类收编）、中英文案 1414 键双向对齐校验、零引用死类清理。③ 主进程与脚本双批次深审（并行子智能体，defect-first）修复全部确认问题：启动链两处错误处理缺口（配置快照写失败可中断 gateway 启动成功路径、app.whenReady 启动体无兜底 catch）、打包产物完整性校验改递归（堵住子目录缺产物漏检）、内核更新检查与换装的并发竞态守卫、WebBridge 更新增加内容级幂等（CDN 不回 ETag 时不再每次自动检查都白白停启守护进程）、插件市场竞速定时器泄漏、tar 硬链接按归档根解析、构建脚本统计口径等 9 项；IPC 来源校验覆盖复查与安全扫描（注入/shell/路径穿越/密钥）零发现。经全量测试（1229 用例）验证。
notes.en: Design-system unification release plus two project-wide deep review batches. (1) Design system unification (B1-B5): all custom components renamed to the oc- prefix (rail, session panel, chat stream, history renderer, resize divider - 355 BEM class references updated); new layout tokens - two-tier content columns (--content-form 720px / --content-wide 1200px), page gutter, and a five-tier z-index contract with every bare titlebar/banner/dialog/lightbox/toast value tokenized; global primitives landed (icon-btn in three sizes plus a danger variant, setting-row, empty-state) absorbing 40+ duplicated icon-button implementations; Tasks page header rebuilt (filters sunk into the toolbar, auto-refresh and manual refresh moved to the header's right side), the Extensions page drops its duplicate third-level nav and 720px content cap, the Appearance page migrates to setting rows, the workspace empty state unified, chat empty-state starter cards gain icons, and the 2px active indicator is now consistent across the rail, session panel, and settings nav. (2) Three style-compliance review rounds: 31 stale CSS fallbacks removed (including a dead --danger alias chain and wrong semantic-color values that caused real rendering drift), 8 duplicated spin animations unified into one global oc-spin, static inline styles cut from 42 to 13 (the rest are legitimately dynamic values; new oc-text-*/oc-flex-1/oc-hidden utility atoms absorb the statics), zh/en dictionaries verified symmetric at 1414 keys each, and zero-reference dead classes pruned. (3) Two main-process and scripts deep-review batches (parallel subagents, defect-first) fixed every confirmed finding: two startup-chain error-handling gaps (a config-snapshot write failure could break the gateway's success path; the app.whenReady body had no catch-all), the packaged-dist completeness check made recursive (subdirectory gaps could slip through), a concurrency guard between kernel-update checks and swaps, content-level idempotency for WebBridge updates (CDNs without ETag no longer restart the daemon on every automatic check), a plugin-market race timer leak, tar hardlinks now resolved relative to the archive root per spec, and build-script accounting fixes - 9 items in all; IPC sender-guard coverage re-verified and security scans (injection/shell/traversal/secrets) came back clean. Verified by the full test suite (1229 cases).

notes.zh: 插件链路五连修：① 检查更新在 ClawHub 不可达时不再报裸超时——解析内核逐插件失败行并经主进程 HTTP 回退重查（用户可配 Registry），部分失败非阻塞提示；② 插件市场打开失败的报错改为可行动指引（网络/代理/Registry 配置），并保留国内镜像末级回退通道（镜像补齐 packages API 后自动生效）；③ 消除每次启动的 image-generation-core 插件清单告警（上游共享库缺 manifest，打包期合成最小清单）；④ 静音 Electron 43 已知 bug 导致的 fs.Stats DEP0180 弃用警告刷屏；⑤ 修复用户市场安装插件与内置镜像副本的重复插件 id 告警（用户副本优先、自动让位），并修复 tavily 等市场插件被误禁用 + "disabled but config is present" 常驻告警（config 暂存重装自动恢复，误禁条目一次性修复）。全量 1225 测试通过。
