notes.en: Plugin pipeline five-fix release: (1) update checks no longer surface raw timeout noise when ClawHub is unreachable — per-plugin kernel failure lines are parsed and retried via main-process HTTP (user-configurable registry), with non-blocking partial-failure notices; (2) plugin market load failures now return actionable guidance (network/proxy/registry) and keep a last-ditch CN-mirror path that activates automatically once the mirror ships the packages API; (3) silenced the recurring image-generation-core manifest warning (upstream shared runtime lib ships without a plugin manifest; we synthesize a minimal one at package time); (4) muted the Electron 43 fs.Stats DEP0180 deprecation-warning spam (known framework bug); (5) fixed duplicate-plugin-id warnings when a market-installed plugin collides with the mirrored copy (user install wins, mirror yields), and fixed market plugins like tavily being wrongly disabled with the persistent "disabled but config is present" warning (configs are stashed and auto-restalled on reinstall, plus a one-time repair of previously mis-disabled entries). 1225 tests green.

notes.zh: 扩展体验五连修与增强：① 技能详情 409 修复——ClawHub 的技能 slug 不全局唯一（同名技能挂不同作者下时详情接口返回 409 AMBIGUOUS_SKILL_SLUG），现在自动解析歧义清单并按作者重试（列表自带作者直传省一跳），主源与国内镜像的响应信封统一适配，说明文档回退安装配置说明；② 插件市场排版重做——发现区改为渐进展示（默认 24 张 + 显示更多，替代原 300+ 卡片墙），同一行卡片的安装按钮/已安装徽标底边对齐，简介统一三行截断、卡片间距加大、区块间加分隔线，热门位不再与推荐位重复，已安装识别修复（官方包名 @openclaw/xxx-plugin 与运行时 id xxx 规范化匹配，已装插件不再出现在推荐位）；③ 插件市场卡片现在可点开详情页（包名/作者/下载量/更新时间/标签，来自 ClawHub 包详情接口）；④ 技能商店与详情新增国内官方镜像自动回退（cn.clawhub-mirror.com，火山引擎/字节跳动支持）——主源网络失败时列表/搜索/详情自动切换镜像，国内弱网不再白屏；⑤ 详情页新增「用 Agent 翻译简介」一键把英文简介/说明组装成翻译提示词填入聊天输入框，用应用内已有模型即时中文化。经全量测试（1209 用例）与 CDP 实机验证（409 消歧、镜像断网回退 E2E、市场排版基线对齐、翻译预填全通过）。
notes.en: Extensions five-fix release: (1) Skill detail 409 fixed - ClawHub slugs are not globally unique (same-name skills under different authors return 409 AMBIGUOUS_SKILL_SLUG), now auto-disambiguated via the owner param with matches-based retry; the primary and CN-mirror response envelopes are both normalized. (2) Plugin market layout overhaul - the discover section now shows 24 cards progressively with a Show more button (replacing the 300+ card wall), same-row action buttons/installed badges share a bottom baseline, summaries clamp to three lines with a min-height, cards get roomier padding with section separators, the trending rail no longer repeats recommended items, and installed detection is fixed (official package names like @openclaw/xxx-plugin now normalize-match runtime ids, so installed plugins no longer appear as recommendations). (3) Market cards now open a detail dialog (package/author/downloads/updated/tags from the ClawHub package API). (4) The skill store gains an automatic official CN mirror fallback (cn.clawhub-mirror.com, backed by Volcano Engine/ByteDance) for list/search/detail when the primary registry is unreachable. (5) Detail dialogs add a Translate with Agent button that assembles the English summary/readme into a translation prompt prefilled into the chat composer. Verified by the full test suite (1209 cases) and live CDP checks (409 disambiguation, mirror failover E2E, market baseline alignment, translate prefill).

notes.zh: 扩展与任务双模块大版本：插件市场与更新体系 + 统一推荐算法 + 任务页重构 + 三轮全库审查 + 性能批次。① 扩展页（技能/插件）全新升级——插件支持一键「检查更新」（内核 plugins update 干跑解析）与单项/全部更新，完成后提示重启网关；插件详情页展示内核 inspect 全量数据（版本/来源/状态/能力/渠道/Provider/工具/钩子/安装记录/兼容性）；技能详情页拉取 ClawHub 完整资料（净化 Markdown 说明文档、作者、标签、更新时间）；插件市场新增「发现」浏览模式：按 7 大分类聚合 ClawHub 包搜索，配「为你推荐 / 热门 / 分类筛选 chips」三路推荐位。② 新设计一套技能与插件市场统一的推荐与发现算法（纯函数库，全量单测覆盖）：信任度 0.40（官方 > 已验证 > 已知 > 未知，安全第一）+ 热度 0.35（log 压缩、5 万封顶防刷量）+ 新鲜度 0.25（30 天半衰）；个性化按已装插件/技能的渠道与供应商线索加权（词边界匹配 ×1.35）；蛇形类目交错保证列表多样性（无 3 连同类）。③ 布局适配：扩展/技能/插件页内容列放宽为 min(94%, 2400px)（实测占窗 90%，满足 ≥85% 要求），技能与市场列表升级为响应式网格铺满窗口。④ 任务页重构：状态统计条（进行中/已完成/失败/其他，点击联动过滤）、防抖搜索（标题/类型/Agent）、来源与 Agent 双筛选、30 秒自动刷新（视图离开与页面隐藏双保险）、失败详情展开收起、错误重试、最近完成一键展开。⑤ 三轮全库审查（并行子智能体）共 19 项发现全部修复，含 2 个 P1：内核 CLI 子进程补 OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR 显式传参（HOME 歧义时插件操作落错目录）、更新与安装/卸载互斥（防内核并发改写插件目录）；kimi-code 验证改逐请求验证头（不再劫持共享代理令牌，验证期间生产流量不再 401）。⑥ 性能批次：插件清单缓存 60s→10min、市场浏览 5min 缓存（原每次 28 路 HTTP）、健康检查前 5 秒 150ms 快轮询、系统守护清理每会话一次（启动提速数百毫秒）、扩展镜像复制异步化（不再卡主进程）、hljs/katex 拆为纯按需分包（每次窗口创建少加载 340KB）。经全量测试（1205 用例）与 CDP 实机冒烟（扩展页/插件详情/任务页/布局占窗比/零裸键/零渲染异常）验证。
notes.en: Extensions and Tasks dual-module release: plugin marketplace + update system, a unified recommendation engine, a Tasks page overhaul, three project-wide review rounds, and a performance pass. (1) Extensions page fully upgraded - plugins gain one-click Check for Updates (kernel plugins update dry-run parsing) with per-plugin and update-all actions plus a restart-gateway prompt; a plugin detail dialog shows the full kernel inspect data (version/origin/status/capabilities/channels/providers/tools/hooks/install record/compatibility); a skill detail dialog fetches the complete ClawHub profile (sanitized Markdown readme, author, tags, updated time); the plugin market gains a Discover browse mode aggregating ClawHub package searches across 7 categories with Recommended-for-you / Trending / category-chip rails. (2) A newly designed recommendation and discovery engine shared by the skill and plugin marketplaces (pure-function library, fully unit-tested): trust 0.40 (official > verified > known > unknown - safety first) + popularity 0.35 (log-scaled, 50k cap) + freshness 0.25 (30-day half-life); personalization boosts items matching installed plugins/skills channel and provider hints (word-boundary match x1.35); snake interleave keeps lists diverse (never 3 same-category in a row). (3) Layout: the extensions/skills/plugins content column widened to min(94%, 2400px) - measured 90% window fill (>= 85% requirement); skill and market lists upgraded to responsive grids. (4) Tasks page overhaul: status stats chips (click-to-filter), debounced search (title/kind/agent), source and agent filters, 30s auto refresh (leave-hook + visibility double guard), failed-detail expand/collapse, error retry, and show-all for recent runs. (5) Three project-wide review rounds (parallel subagents) fixed all 19 findings including 2 P1s: kernel CLI subprocesses now get an explicit OPENCLAW_STATE_DIR (HOME drift used to target the wrong state dir), and plugin update/install/uninstall are fully mutexed; kimi-code verification now uses a per-request verify header instead of hijacking the shared proxy token (in-flight traffic no longer 401s during verification). (6) Performance: plugin list cache 60s->10min, market browse 5min cache (was 28 HTTP requests per visit), health check 150ms fast-poll for the first 5s, system-daemon cleanup once per session (hundreds of ms faster startup), async extension-mirror copying (no more main-process stalls), and hljs/katex split into on-demand-only chunks (340KB less forced loading per window). Verified by the full test suite (1205 cases) and live CDP smoke checks (extensions page, plugin detail, tasks page, window-fill ratio, zero bare i18n keys, zero renderer exceptions).

notes.zh: 实时思考区滚动方向调整：折叠单行条带由横向滚动改为垂直向上滚动（上下滚动）——最新思考文本在单行窗口内持续向上流动，两侧渐隐改为上下渐隐；系统「减弱动态效果」开启时静止并钉住最新输出；展开态正文保持限高滚动并自动滚到最新。其余体验不变：默认折叠单行、点击展开完整推理。经全量测试（1150 用例）与 CDP 实测（动画激活、单行窗口 15px、内容纵向滚动、全程保持折叠）验证。
notes.en: Live-thinking ticker direction change: the collapsed single-line strip now scrolls vertically upward (top-to-bottom flow) instead of horizontally - the latest thinking text streams upward through the one-line window, with top/bottom edge fades; it stays static and pinned to the newest output when the OS prefers reduced motion; the expanded view keeps its height-capped auto-scroll-to-latest behavior. Everything else is unchanged: collapsed single line by default, click to expand full reasoning. Verified by the full test suite (1150 cases) and live CDP checks (animation active, 15px single-line window, vertical overflow scrolling, collapsed throughout).

notes.zh: 实时思考区体验优化 + 全项目审查清理。① 实时思考区改为默认折叠单行：思考进行中在「思考中」标签旁以单行滚动条带持续展示最新思考输出（无缝 marquee 滚动动画，两侧渐隐，系统开启「减弱动态效果」时自动静止），点击可展开完整推理内容，展开态自动滚动到最新——既保留实时可见性又不打断对话阅读。② 全项目代码审查：消除本轮引入的两处重复代码（阶段标签文案提取为共享函数、用量页日期范围计算复用纯函数库），jscpd 重复行进一步下降；全量测试与类型检查通过，桌面与窄窗口（900px）双布局探针确认聊天页与设置各页零横向溢出。经全量测试（1150 用例）与 CDP 实测（思考区全程折叠 29 采样帧、滚动动画激活、tail 持续更新）验证。
notes.en: Live-thinking region UX polish plus a project-wide review cleanup. (1) The live thinking region now defaults to a collapsed single line: while the model is reasoning, the newest thinking output continuously streams through a one-line marquee next to the "Thinking" label (seamless scroll animation with edge fades, automatically static when the OS prefers reduced motion); click to expand the full reasoning, and the expanded view auto-scrolls to the latest output. (2) Project-wide review: removed the two duplication blocks introduced last round (shared phase-status label helper; usage tab now reuses the pure date-range library), shrinking the jscpd footprint; full tests and type checks pass, and layout probes on desktop and a 900px viewport confirm zero horizontal overflow across the chat view and settings pages. Verified by the full test suite (1150 cases) and live CDP checks (collapsed across 29 sampled frames, marquee active, tail continuously updating).

notes.zh: 流式输出大版本：思考过程实时流式 + 工具间解说实时流式 + 输出自愈强化 + 仪表盘适配 + 用量页重构 + 多项修复。① 思考过程支持流式输出——模型推理内容现在随生成实时显示在聊天中（可折叠、自动滚动），不再等回复结束才出现。② 修复中途消息输出的流式输出——工具调用之间的解说文本此前要等整轮结束才显示，现在与官方网页端一致实时流式呈现并按时间序冻结进对话时间线（基于对网关内核 2026.9.3 preamble 事件机制的取证）。③ 输出自愈强化——流式帧丢失（序列号断档/断线重连收养）后，后续帧以网关附带的全量快照自动纠偏（对齐官方合并算法），不再把增量追加在坏基线上；新增对网关 seq-gap 错误事件的消费，触发静默历史对齐。④ 修复点击文件卡片无反应——主进程把 shell.openPath 的失败返回串转为拒绝（此前文件不存在/无关联程序时点击零反馈）；聊天文件卡片与主进程安全白名单两侧清单对齐并加一致性守卫测试，代码类文件点击自动降级为「在文件夹中定位」。⑤ 适配内核仪表盘（board）功能——会话带仪表盘时聊天页自动出现可折叠仪表盘面板，widget 经网关票据化 URL 安全渲染，board.changed 事件实时刷新。⑥ 「会话用量」重构为「用量」——参照官方 /usage 页：今天/近7天/近30天/全部范围切换、总Token/总成本/会话数/消息数指标卡、每日活动堆叠图、模型/服务商用量分布、会话明细（含成本列）。⑦ 修复输入框模型显示空白——内核会话行的裸模型 id（无服务商前缀）现在会解析回完整键名显示，未知模型补动态选项不再匹配失败；思考强度档位解析同步改用会话实际生效模型。⑧ 执行权限挡位对齐最新内核（2026.9.3 五档：deny/allowlist/ask/auto/full），设置页高级 tab 提供完整五档。经全量测试（1148 用例）与 CDP 实测验证。
notes.en: Streaming release: live thinking output, live mid-run commentary, stronger stream self-healing, dashboard adaptation, a rebuilt Usage page, and multiple fixes. (1) Thinking is now streamed live in the chat as the model reasons (collapsible, auto-scrolling) instead of appearing only after the reply finishes. (2) Fixed mid-run message streaming - commentary text between tool calls now streams in real time (matching the official web console) and freezes into the timeline in order, based on forensics of the gateway kernel 2026.9.3 preamble event mechanism. (3) Stronger output self-healing - after a lost streaming frame (seq gap / reconnect adoption), later frames self-correct from the full snapshot the gateway attaches (aligned with the official merge algorithm) instead of appending onto a corrupted base; gateway seq-gap error events are now consumed to trigger a silent history re-align. (4) Fixed file-card clicks doing nothing - the main process now converts shell.openPath failure strings into rejections (missing file / no association used to be silently ignored); the chat file-card list and the main-process safe-open whitelist are aligned with a consistency guard test, and code-type files fall back to "reveal in folder". (5) Adapted the kernel dashboard (board) feature - sessions with a board get a collapsible dashboard panel in the chat view; widgets render via ticketed gateway URLs and refresh on board.changed events. (6) The "Session Usage" tab is rebuilt as "Usage" following the official /usage page: today/7d/30d/all ranges, token/cost/session/message metric cards, a daily activity chart, model/provider breakdowns, and a session list with costs. (7) Fixed a blank model selector - bare model ids from kernel session rows now resolve to full keys for display, unknown models get a dynamic option, and thinking-level resolution now uses the session effective model. (8) Exec permission modes aligned with the latest kernel (2026.9.3 five modes: deny/allowlist/ask/auto/full) in Settings > Advanced. Verified by the full test suite (1148 cases) and live CDP checks.

notes.zh: 记忆系统大版本：修复 Embedding 配置被回滚 + 记忆页重构 + 记忆不可用修复方案落地。① 修复核心 Bug——在设置里改过 Embedding 服务商/模型后，重启应用会被 Kimi 预设悄悄覆盖回去：现在启动自愈只修正本地代理端口漂移，用户改过的服务商、模型、地址、密钥一律保留；用户禁用语义检索也不再被强制重新开启。② 记忆设置页重构为四个分页（参照 OpenClaw 官方记忆管理页设计）：「概览」=功能状态卡（实时探测/刷新/一键启用插件/重建索引）+8 格统计墙+召回测试（与真实对话同一检索管线，附示例查询）+危险区（清空短期信号/清空梦境日记，二次确认）；「记忆」=长期记忆+每日日志统一列表（搜索/分页/展开全文/新建记忆，自动备份）；「梦境」=今夜梦境+历史梦境（查看/删除，删除前自动备份）；「设置」=原设置表单原样保留。③ 「记忆插件不可用」修复方案落地（基于对网关内核 2026.9.3 的实测取证）：内核升级后索引过期会静默导致搜索空结果，现在召回测试会明确提示并给一键重建；sqlite-vec 向量库 DLL 在 ASAR 虚拟路径内加载失败会静默降级内置 KNN，现在自动把 extensionPath 指到真实 DLL；memory-core 插件被禁用时概览页给一键启用。经三轮代码审查（自查+缺陷盲审+终审）与全量测试（968 用例）验证。
notes.en: Memory-system release: fixes the embedding-config revert, redesigns the memory page, and lands the memory-unavailable remediation. (1) Core bug fixed - changing the embedding provider/model in Settings used to be silently overwritten by the Kimi preset on every app restart; startup healing now only fixes local proxy port drift, and user-set provider/model/endpoint/key are never touched, and disabling semantic recall is respected. (2) The memory settings page is redesigned into four sub-tabs (following the official OpenClaw memory-page design): Overview = live status card (probe/refresh/one-click plugin enable/index rebuild) + an 8-cell stats wall + a recall test using the exact same retrieval pipeline as real chats (with example queries) + a danger zone (reset short-term signals / clear dream diary, with confirmation); Memories = unified list of long-term and daily entries (search/pagination/expand/new-entry with automatic backup); Dreams = tonight + history with view/delete (auto-backup before delete); Settings = the previous settings form unchanged. (3) The memory-plugin-unavailable remediation landed (based on live forensics of gateway kernel 2026.9.3): a stale index after kernel upgrades silently yields empty search results - the recall test now surfaces this with one-click rebuild; the sqlite-vec vector DLL failed to load from the ASAR virtual path, silently degrading to built-in KNN - the app now points extensionPath at the real DLL automatically; when the memory-core plugin is disabled, the overview offers one-click enable. Verified through three code-review rounds (self + defect-blind + final) and the full test suite (968 cases).

notes.zh: 更新链路修复 + 记忆/联想能力升级：① 应用更新三处修复——禁用差分下载（弱网下 GitHub 分段请求反复失败且失败后需全量重下，双份流量；改全量单连接断点续传）；点击「立即更新」即刻显示下载进度（原首个进度事件前有数秒静默期）；下载期间拒绝并发检查请求（此前一次并发检查会把进度条打断，疑似卡死）；安装阶段改为带进度窗口的可见换装（原全程静默在本机实测 10 分钟零 UI）。② 记忆设置「语义检索（智能联想）」支持自定义服务商：服务商下拉新增「已配置的服务商」分组（复用 Provider 页接入的 openai 兼容服务商，自动继承其接口地址），并新增 API Key 输入（支持设置/清除，密钥脱敏存储）；③ 记忆设置的「归档用模型」「整理用模型」「检索用模型」从手填文本框升级为下拉选择（列出已配置模型，可选「跟随默认模型」）；④ 记忆设置页全部文案专业化重写（如「翻记忆」→「主动记忆检索」）；⑤ WebBridge 连接可靠性：修复每次启动都提示「连接你的常用浏览器」——扩展启用检测从仅查浏览器 Default 配置升级为全配置扫描，并新增 daemon 活连接短路判定 + 启动时自动拉起守护进程 + 提示可见期间 30 秒自动复判。经独立代码审查三轮与全量测试验证。
notes.en: Update-pipeline fixes plus memory/recall upgrades: (1) App updater - three fixes: differential downloads disabled (GitHub ranged requests repeatedly failed on weak networks and each failure forced a full re-download, doubling traffic; now a single resumable full download); clicking Update now shows download progress immediately (there used to be a multi-second silent gap before the first progress event); concurrent check requests during a download are now rejected (a racing check previously reset the progress bar, looking like a hung download); the install phase now shows a visible progress window instead of a fully silent swap that took 10+ minutes with zero UI. (2) Memory settings - semantic recall now supports custom providers: the provider dropdown gains a Configured providers group (reuses openai-compatible providers set up on the Provider tab, inheriting their endpoints) plus a new API key field (set/clear, stored redacted). (3) The memory tab model fields (archiving/organization/retrieval models) upgraded from free-text inputs to dropdowns listing configured models with a follow-default option. (4) All memory-tab copy professionally rewritten. (5) WebBridge reliability: fixed the connect-your-browser prompt reappearing on every launch - extension detection now scans all browser profiles instead of only Default, adds a live daemon-connection short-circuit, auto-starts the daemon at launch, and the prompt re-evaluates every 30s while visible. Verified through independent code review and the full test suite.

notes.zh: QA 修复批次（三项实拍问题 + 全面审查）：① 全应用按钮样式退化根因修复——样式文件一条注释结尾多写了一个斜杠，打包后把按钮基础样式规则变成非法选择器被浏览器静默丢弃，所有按钮退化成原生外观；现修复并新增构建期+单测双防线（CSS 选择器含游离斜杠即构建失败），删除类按钮红色对比度同步加深。② 对话页工具调用卡片现在显示工具类型：修复内置工具图标因配置键名不匹配而全部丢失的问题，所有工具类型改为中文友好名（如「执行命令」「读取文件」），插件/MCP 工具显示「类型 · 来源」徽标（如 搜索 · anysearch）而不是内部原始名，回复前的「调用工具…」提示同步。③ 记忆设置页为新手重排：会话记忆与智能联想合并为「记住对话内容」主卡、技术参数收进高级折叠区、「记忆固化（Dreaming）」更名「自动整理记忆」并把定时输入换成常用时间下拉，全部文案通俗化。经三轮代码审查（自查+独立盲审+复核）与全量测试（670 UI 用例等）验证。
notes.en: QA fix batch (three field-reported issues plus a full review): (1) Fixed the root cause of every button across the app degrading to native browser styling - a stray extra slash after a CSS comment terminator turned the base button rule into an invalid selector that browsers silently dropped in the packaged bundle; fixed, with new build-time + unit-test guards that fail the build on any stray slash in a CSS selector, and destructive buttons got a stronger red for contrast. (2) Chat tool-call cards now show the tool type: fixed built-in tool icons never rendering due to a config key-name mismatch, all tool types get friendly localized names (e.g. "Run command", "Read file"), and plugin/MCP tools display a "type - source" badge (e.g. Search - anysearch) instead of raw internal names; the "calling tool..." indicator before replies matches. (3) The memory settings page was reorganized for non-technical users: session memory and smart recall merged into a single "Remember conversations" card with technical parameters tucked into Advanced sections, "Dreaming" renamed "Auto-tidy memories" with a preset schedule dropdown replacing the raw cron input, and all copy rewritten in plain language. Verified via three review rounds (self + independent + recheck) and the full test suite (670 UI cases etc.).

notes.zh: 界面一致性批次：① 布尔开关统一到 oc-toggle-switch 组件——「终端命令」一行此前与同页其他开关用的是两套手搓实现（视觉细节易漂移、键盘语义重复维护），组件新增富文本标签插槽后完成迁移，同页三种开关视觉完全一致；② 设置页 8 个标签页的页面级描述文字从表单提示级的弱灰提升为次级文字色（暗色主题下原对比度仅约 4.2:1，整页导读不该这么弱），表单内提示保持原样。
notes.en: UI consistency batch: (1) boolean toggles unified onto the oc-toggle-switch component - the "terminal command" row had been using a second hand-rolled toggle implementation alongside the component used by its neighbors (visual drift risk plus duplicated keyboard semantics); the component gained a rich-label slot and the row migrated, so all toggles on the page render identically. (2) The page-level description text on 8 settings tabs moved from form-hint-grade muted gray to the secondary text color (in the dark theme the old contrast was only ~4.2:1 - a full-page lead-in should not be that weak); in-form hints are unchanged.

notes.zh: 文档一致性批次（不改代码）：开发者文档与实际实现全面对齐——架构文档修正 10 处过时陈述（IPC 通道数、测试基线数字、已删除的模块、Node 22→24、令牌注入方式、Windows 健康检查超时、日志路径、设置页 13 个标签页清单、NSIS 静默安装描述等）；IPC 参考补全 24 个此前漏记的方法与 2 个事件监听器（内核升级、插件商店、WebBridge、诊断导出、剪贴板等），现与 preload 白名单 108 通道逐一核对零缺失；README/贡献指南的测试基线（657/447→1078）与内核版本 pin（2026.7→2026.9.3）同步；30 秒轮询定时器的隐藏降频行为写入机制文档。
notes.en: Documentation-consistency batch (no code changes): developer docs realigned with the actual implementation - the architecture doc fixes 10 stale claims (IPC channel counts, test baseline numbers, a deleted module, Node 22 to 24, token injection mechanism, Windows health-check timeout, log paths, the 13-tab settings list, the NSIS silent-install description); the IPC reference gains 24 previously undocumented methods and 2 event listeners (kernel upgrade, plugin store, WebBridge, diagnostics export, clipboard), now verified against the 108-channel preload whitelist with zero missing; README/CONTRIBUTING test baselines (657/447 to 1078) and the kernel version pin (2026.7 to 2026.9.3) synced; the 30s ticker hidden-window throttling documented.

notes.zh: 启动与空闲性能优化：① 用户配置读取增加原文缓存（键控修改时间+大小）——启动链路原本要连续全文件读取+解析 10 余次（迁移、端口/令牌解析、健康检查等），Windows 实时杀软扫描叠加下是启动期最大的重复同步 IO，现在未变化时只做一次磁盘读；外部改写自动失效，语义与无缓存完全一致。② 网关就绪推送提前：健康探测通过后的等待从 300ms 缩短到 100ms（世代计数器仍是主防线），界面可提前约 200ms 重连。③ 窗口隐藏到托盘后：30 秒轮询（每轮 3-4 个网关请求）与渲染进程内存采样停止，恢复可见立即补一轮——挂后台不再空转流量。④ clawhub CLI 包装器只在内容变化时写盘（此前每次网关启动都重写）；webbridge 状态检查（要拉注册表和进程列表）推迟 1.5 秒不再挤占首屏；两处长周期定时器补 unref。
notes.en: Startup and idle-performance optimizations: (1) user-config reads now cache the raw text keyed by (mtime, size) - the boot chain previously read + parsed the full file 10+ times in a row (migrations, port/token resolution, health inspection...), the biggest repeated sync IO during startup once Windows real-time AV scanning is factored in; unchanged files are now read from disk only once, external rewrites invalidate the cache, and semantics are identical to no cache. (2) Gateway-ready push is earlier: the post-health-probe wait shrank from 300ms to 100ms (the generation counter remains the primary guard), letting the UI reconnect ~200ms sooner. (3) While the window is hidden to tray: the 30s polling loop (3-4 gateway requests per tick) and the renderer memory sampler now stop, with an immediate catch-up tick on becoming visible - no more idle traffic when parked in background. (4) The clawhub CLI wrapper is only rewritten when content changes (previously rewritten on every gateway start); the webbridge status check (which enumerates the registry and process list) is deferred by 1.5s off the first-paint path; two long-lived timers got unref.

notes.zh:
可靠性与资源泄漏修复（生命周期审查批次）：① 内核更新子进程在应用退出时不再遗留——此前退出应用后换装脚本最长还能再跑 15 分钟，在无人执行回滚的状态下改写程序文件；② 修复 WebBridge 下载失败路径不关闭写流的问题（Windows 下句柄未关会让临时文件删不掉，反复重试逐次泄漏）；③ 退出路径统一：渲染层退出、安装更新、恢复出厂此前都跳过 token 刷新停止与遥测冲刷（app_closed 事件丢失），现与托盘退出共用同一幂等清理；④ 更新器初始化加重入守卫、托盘主题监听随销毁摘除、状态导出 zip 数据管异常兜底。
安全面收敛：移除 9 条零调用的 IPC 通道（渠道白名单添加 ×3、WebBridge 状态/安装/清理 ×3、技能详情、工作区打开文件、打开设置）——preload 白名单从 117 方法收缩到 108。
notes.en:
Reliability and resource-leak fixes (lifecycle audit batch): (1) the kernel-updater child process is no longer orphaned when the app quits mid-update - previously the swap script could keep running for up to 15 minutes rewriting program files with nobody alive to run the rollback; (2) fixed the WebBridge download failure path leaving the write stream open (on Windows an open handle makes the temp file undeletable, leaking one fd + orphan file per retry); (3) unified quit paths - quitting from the renderer, installing an update, and factory reset previously all skipped stopping the token-refresh timer and flushing telemetry (app_closed events were lost); they now share the same idempotent teardown as tray quit; (4) added a re-entry guard to the updater init, tray theme listener is now removed on destroy, and the state-export zip data pump got an exception guard.
Attack-surface reduction: removed 9 zero-call IPC channels (channel allowlist add x3, WebBridge status/install/clean x3, skill detail, workspace open-file, open settings) - the preload whitelist shrinks from 117 to 108 methods.

notes.zh: 死代码清理（发行包瘦身）：移除 chat-ui 中从未被引用的平行组件套件——cc-btn/cc-card/cc-input/cc-select/cc-textarea/cc-menu/cc-skeleton/cc-table/cc-tabs/cc-chip 原语与 .btn.secondary/.btn.ghost 变体（各视图实际使用 .btn kit 与组件私有类，两套并存已久），连带 28 个零引用的间距工具类、6 处散落的死样式块，primitives.css 从 635 行减至 216 行。设计规范文档（中英）同步：删除已移除原语的描述，标注清理记录。零功能改动，全部删除项均经全仓引用扫描证实为零使用。
notes.en: Dead-code cleanup (bundle slimming): removed the never-referenced parallel component kit from the chat UI - the cc-btn/cc-card/cc-input/cc-select/cc-textarea/cc-menu/cc-skeleton/cc-table/cc-tabs/cc-chip primitives plus .btn.secondary/.btn.ghost variants (views actually use the .btn kit and component-scoped classes; the two systems had coexisted unused for a long time), along with 28 zero-reference spacing utility classes and 6 scattered dead rule blocks; primitives.css went from 635 to 216 lines. Design guideline docs (zh/en) synced: descriptions of removed primitives deleted with cleanup annotations. Zero functional change - every removed item was verified zero-use by repo-wide reference scans.

notes.zh:
安全加固（纵深防御）：Kimi 登录打开浏览器前先校验授权链接必须是 https 且 kimi.com 域（此前授权端点若被劫持可让应用打开任意网址，与设置页链接的协议白名单对齐）；ClawHub Registry 自定义地址现在只接受 https（本机镜像可用 http://localhost）——明文 http 的技能源会被中间人篡改技能内容，进而引导 agent 行为，写入时即拦截并提示。
设计令牌：弹窗投影从硬编码色值提升为 --shadow-dialog 令牌，暗色主题改用深黑基调投影（旧的浅色墨水值在暗色下发灰，弹窗叠弹窗分离度不足）。
清理：移除 3 个无引用的死函数与 2 处过度导出的内部函数、一段死 CSS；文档同步（设置页 13 个 tab 的过时清单、IPC 方法计数、测试基线数字），已闭环的安全整改记录与被取代的旧内核调研归档至 docs/archive/。全量回归 1077 pass / 0 fail。
notes.en:
Security hardening (defense in depth): before opening the browser for Kimi login, the authorization URL must now be https on a kimi.com domain (a hijacked OAuth endpoint could previously make the app open an arbitrary URL; this aligns it with the protocol allowlist used elsewhere). Custom ClawHub registry addresses now must use https (http://localhost allowed for local mirrors) - a cleartext skill registry can be tampered with in transit and skill content steers agent behavior, so invalid schemes are rejected at save time with a clear message.
Design tokens: the dialog shadow moved from a hardcoded value to a --shadow-dialog token; the dark theme now uses a deep black-based shadow (the old light-ink value looked washed-out gray on dark backgrounds and lacked separation for stacked dialogs).
Cleanup: 3 unreferenced dead functions and 2 over-exported internals removed, plus a dead CSS block; docs synced (stale 14-tab settings list, IPC method counts, test baseline numbers), and the closed-out security remediation log plus the superseded old kernel research were archived under docs/archive/. Full regression: 1077 pass / 0 fail.

notes.zh:
内核升级 openclaw 2026.9.2 → 2026.9.3，捆绑运行时同步 Node 22 → 24.21（新版内核要求 Node ≥24.16，旧运行时会在安装期被直接拒绝）。协议层纯增量（新增 transcripts.export/status 等 6 个 RPC），渠道/技能/配置零迁移；针对内核产物从 .js 翻转为 .mjs 的新形态，补丁扫描与覆盖断言已同步扩展并补齐回归测试。
性能优化（长对话/工具密集场景）：工具运行期间界面从每 80ms 全量重算消息派生（卡片抽取/JSON 检测/图片扫描）改为按消息缓存——工具密集任务连续调用数十次工具时的周期性卡顿显著降低；超长流式回复（>5 万字符）的重复解析净化改为帧间复用；会话搜索加入防抖，大量会话下连续击键不再逐键重过滤整列表；后台任务事件改为本地增量应用，任务视图打开时不再每个事件都全量重拉。
词条与文案：3 处超长悬浮提示在英文界面下溢出屏幕的问题修复（改为可换行的宽提示）；斜杠命令的中文描述与用量面板的重置文案迁入双语词典（此前硬编码，英文界面会漏译）；清理 3 条遗留死词条；界面裸词条扫描的覆盖面从 8 个前缀族扩展到全部 30 个。
其他：修复开发隔离模式下状态目录相对路径解析错误（该 bug 在旧内核下被静默掩盖、会误读生产配置）；移除两处随包分发的无用代码。
notes.en:
Kernel upgrade: openclaw 2026.9.2 -> 2026.9.3, with the bundled runtime moving from Node 22 to 24.21 (the new kernel requires Node >=24.16 and rejects the old runtime at install time). The protocol surface is purely additive (6 new RPCs including transcripts.export/status); channels, skills and config need no migration. The kernel's dist chunks flipped from .js to .mjs - our patch scanner and coverage assertions now handle the new shape, with regression tests added.
Performance (long conversations / tool-heavy runs): during tool runs the UI recomputed every message derivation (card extraction, JSON detection, image scanning) every 80ms; these are now cached per message, removing the periodic stutter of long tool-heavy agent runs. Extra-long streaming replies (>50k chars) reuse the previous frame's parse instead of re-sanitizing every frame. Session search is debounced so rapid typing no longer refilters the whole list per keystroke, and background-task events are applied locally instead of re-fetching the full list per event while the tasks view is open.
Copy & i18n: three over-long tooltips that overflowed the screen in the English UI now wrap; the Chinese slash-command descriptions and the usage-panel reset labels moved into the bilingual dictionary (previously hardcoded, leaking Chinese into the English UI); 3 dead dictionary entries removed; the bare-i18n-key UI scan now covers all 30 key families (was 8).
Also: fixed relative state-directory resolution in isolated dev mode (silently masked by the old kernel, which fell back to the production config), and removed two pieces of dead code that shipped in the package.

notes.zh: 可靠性：核心服务（网关）进程意外崩溃后现在会自动重启恢复——此前崩溃后没有任何重启路径（界面只反复重连一个已经死掉的连接），用户会一直停在「无法连接到 Gateway」直到手动重启应用。新逻辑：检测到非预期退出后延迟 3 秒重启，5 分钟窗口内最多 3 次（防止崩溃循环拖垮系统），达上限则转入设置页的人工恢复入口并给出提示；应用正在退出时不再拉起新进程。
notes.en: Reliability: the core service (gateway) process now auto-restarts after an unexpected crash. Previously a crash had no recovery path at all - the UI only kept retrying a connection whose process was already dead - so users were stuck at "cannot connect to Gateway" until they relaunched the app. New behaviour: after an unexpected exit the gateway is restarted 3s later, at most 3 times within a rolling 5-minute window (crash-loop protection), and on exceeding that limit the app routes to the manual recovery entry in Settings with a notice; no new process is spawned while the app is quitting.

notes.zh: 修复（交互审查发现）：通用确认弹窗（含「恢复出厂设置」等危险操作）此前遮罩不响应点击，导致上一版加入的 Escape 关闭对它无效——现在 Escape 优先点击弹窗内显式标记的「取消」按钮（7 处弹窗补齐标记），危险确认框也能用键盘取消，且不会误触确认。
notes.en: Fix (found by interaction audit): the shared confirm dialog (used by dangerous actions such as factory reset) had no overlay click handler, so the Escape-to-close added in the previous release did nothing for it - Escape now clicks the dialog's explicitly marked cancel button (markers added across 7 dialogs), so dangerous confirmations can be cancelled from the keyboard without any risk of triggering confirm.

notes.zh: 无障碍改进（键盘/读屏可用性批次）：① 全部 9 个模态弹窗（确认框、更新、重启网关、WebBridge 修复、发布说明、分享、网关地址确认等）现在支持 Escape 关闭，打开时焦点自动移入弹窗——此前键盘用户无法关闭弹窗、读屏用户被困在遮罩层外的页面上；② 会话列表行、工作区文件树与导航节点、Git 文件行、worktree 卡片、设置页 CLI 开关补齐 role/tabindex 与 Enter/Space 触发——此前这些可点击行 Tab 都到不了；③ 新增键盘交互工具模块（含长按 repeat 防护与 Space 滚动拦截）并加单测锁定语义
notes.en: Accessibility improvements (keyboard/screen-reader pass): (1) all 9 modal dialogs (confirm, update, restart gateway, WebBridge repair, release notes, share, gateway URL confirmation, ...) can now be dismissed with Escape, and focus moves into the dialog when it opens - previously keyboard users could not close them and screen-reader users were stranded on the page behind the overlay; (2) session list rows, the workspace file tree and nav nodes, Git file rows, worktree cards and the settings CLI switch now carry role/tabindex and respond to Enter/Space - these clickable rows were previously unreachable by Tab; (3) a shared keyboard-interaction helper module (with key-repeat guard and Space scroll prevention) was added with unit tests locking the semantics.

notes.zh:
WebBridge 修复永久化（根因定位并根治）：上游把 latest 产物当可反复重建的发布位——实测同一文件重建后字节数完全不变、仅 Go build ID 等约 177 字节元数据变化（2026-09-10 一天内两次），而钉定值写在 App 内，导致每次上游重建都要等发新版才能修复。现改为**可自动更新的远端钉定清单**（托管在本仓库 resources/webbridge-pins.json，修复时经 jsDelivr / raw.githubusercontent 自动拉取并缓存 24 小时，内置表仅作兜底）：上游再换新时维护者只需更新该清单，用户无需升级 App 即可修复；校验仍是精确 sha256 比对，内置表与远端清单都不匹配时维持 fail closed 拒装。本版同时把内置钉定表更新到当前值
本版含第二轮功能/页面审查修复 10 项：全新安装（gateway 未启动）时选 Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/Moonshot-CN 不再因模型控件整体消失而无法完成安装（静态候选兜底 + 「自定义模型」入口始终可达）；更新弹窗「重试下载」此前必然失败（错误态被下载入口拒绝）→ 改为先重新检查再下载；中文界面下文档语言标记正确同步（读屏发音/CJK 字体）；侧栏会话重命名/置顶/未读/归档失败不再静默无反应（统一提示）；安装向导第三步 WebBridge 开关支持键盘；断连时新建 worktree 不再假成功；图片放大支持键盘；移除 6 处违反设计规范的 text-transform: uppercase；修复消息框残留的退役 indigo 兜底色；IPC 文档补齐 workspace/git 通道并移除已退役的幽灵行
notes.en:
WebBridge repair made permanent (root cause found and fixed): upstream treats the "latest" artifacts as a rebuildable publish slot - a rebuilt binary keeps the exact same byte length and differs only in ~177 bytes of Go build metadata (including the Go build ID), observed twice on 2026-09-10. With the pin table baked into the app, every upstream rebuild broke repair until a new release shipped. Pins now come from an auto-updatable remote manifest (hosted in this repo as resources/webbridge-pins.json; fetched at repair time via jsDelivr / raw.githubusercontent and cached for 24h, with the embedded table as fallback): when upstream rotates again, updating that file fixes users without an app release. Verification is still an exact sha256 comparison, and it stays fail-closed when neither source matches. The embedded table is also refreshed to the current values.
This release also includes 10 fixes from the second functional/page review round: on a fresh install (gateway not yet running), choosing Anthropic/OpenAI/Google/Moonshot-CN no longer blocks setup because the model control disappeared (static candidate list fallback + the "custom model" entry is always reachable); the update dialog's "retry download" used to fail unconditionally (the download entry point rejects the error state) - it now re-checks first; the document language marker now follows the active locale (screen-reader pronunciation/CJK font selection); sidebar session rename/pin/unread/archive failures are no longer silent (unified toast); the setup step-3 WebBridge toggle is keyboard-operable; creating a worktree while disconnected no longer reports success; image zoom is keyboard-accessible; removed 6 design-rule-violating text-transform: uppercase declarations; fixed a retired-indigo fallback colour in the message box; IPC docs now cover the workspace/git channels and drop a retired phantom row.

notes.zh:
WebBridge 供应链钉定随上游更新（修复用户报告的「修复失败：sha256 校验失败」）：上游 CDN 于 2026-09-10 换新了全部三平台产物（curl/Node 双通道下载哈希一致、CDN Last-Modified 同日，属上游正常发版而非传输污染），钉定表已重新取证更新；修复路径遇到「钉定表已更新但本机仍是旧产物」时不再直接报错，而是作废旧产物自动重下，一次点击即可恢复。面向用户的钉定不符报错从含内部哈希/排障环境变量的原文改为可操作的「请升级 CryoClaw 后重试」（哈希细节保留在日志）
本轮功能与页面审查修复 17 项：
安装/配置：Windows 上「卸载旧版 OpenClaw」此前因 npm.cmd 不能被直接 spawn（Node 安全补丁后必抛 EINVAL）而静默失效、冲突仍在——现经 cmd.exe 调用真正卸载；设置-高级页加载失败不再静默用默认值（浏览器模式/开机自启/ClawHub 源）覆写用户真实配置（改为禁止保存并提示）；外部通道插件写配置后同步状态基线（防止 .bak 回退抹掉 plugins.allow 导致「能登录但永远不回消息」）
对话与页面：模型选择器显示当前会话真实模型（此前切会话后仍显示上个会话选的模型，实际按本会话模型运行）且切换失败回滚；Kimi 扫码登录轮询容忍瞬时网络抖动（连续 5 次失败才放弃，不再单次抖动即中断）；定时任务在「每日/表达式」间切换时时间字段自动归一化（不再显示有效时间却提示无效）；技能页计数与列表过滤口径一致；问答卡倒计时秒级刷新、过期卡片自动回收
构建/发版：clawhub CLI 依赖版本钉定（此前是唯一 "latest" 依赖，发行产物随构建时机漂移且不进增量缓存戳）；CI 脚本测试清单改为动态生成（此前引用已删除的测试文件且漏跑 5 个测试文件）、改用 npm ci + 依赖缓存、Node 版本与发行运行时对齐；官网第三处版本徽章纳入自动刷新
notes.en:
WebBridge supply-chain pins refreshed for the upstream update (fixes the reported "repair failed: sha256 mismatch"): the upstream CDN replaced all three platform artifacts on 2026-09-10 (identical hashes across independent curl/Node downloads, CDN Last-Modified same day - a normal upstream release, not transfer corruption), so the pin table was re-collected and updated. The repair path no longer hard-fails when the pin table is newer than the on-disk artifact: it discards the stale binary and re-downloads, recovering in a single click. The user-facing pin-mismatch error is now an actionable "update CryoClaw and retry" instead of raw hashes and a developer escape hatch (details stay in the log).
Functional and page-by-page review fixes, 17 items:
Install/config: on Windows, "uninstall the old OpenClaw" silently did nothing because npm.cmd cannot be spawned directly (EINVAL after Node's security patch), leaving the conflict in place - it now runs through cmd.exe and truly uninstalls; the Advanced settings page no longer silently overwrites real user configuration (browser mode / launch-at-login / ClawHub registry) with defaults when loading fails (Save is blocked with an error instead); external channel plugins now sync the config state baseline after writing (prevents a .bak rollback from dropping plugins.allow, which left channels logged in but never replying).
Chat/pages: the model selector shows the current session's actual model (it previously kept showing the model chosen in the previous session while the kernel ran the current session's model) and rolls back on a failed switch; Kimi device-code login polling tolerates transient network errors (gives up only after 5 consecutive failures instead of aborting on one blip); cron scheduling normalizes the time field when switching between daily/expression modes (no more "valid time shown but invalid time reported"); the skills page count matches the filtered list; question-card countdown ticks every second and expired cards are reclaimed.
Build/release: the clawhub CLI dependency is now version-pinned (it was the only "latest" dependency, so shipped artifacts drifted with build timing and bypassed the incremental cache stamp); the CI script-test list is generated dynamically (it referenced a deleted test file and silently skipped 5 test files), CI uses npm ci with dependency caching, and its Node version matches the shipped runtime; the website's third version badge now auto-refreshes.

notes.zh:
供应链加固：WebBridge 浏览器接管二进制的下载启用 sha256 内容钉定——CDN 只暴露 latest 别名且内容上游随时可变，此前下载即执行的二进制没有任何完整性校验；现在三平台产物全部过哈希校验才允许落盘执行（repair 路径的既有二进制同样复验），上游换新内容后哈希不匹配将拒装并按既有设计降级 openclaw 模式（不砖），升级需随版本更新钉定表，排障留 KIMI_WEBBRIDGE_SKIP_PIN 逃生门
CLI 兼容冒烟脚本修复：cmd.exe 参数引号策略（含空格参数不再被拆散、含空格 wrapper 路径的 /s 形态按契约补外层引号包裹，用户名含空格的机器不再整体失败）；实测 13/13 断言通过
notes.en:
Supply-chain hardening: WebBridge browser-takeover binaries now verify a pinned sha256 on download before anything is executed. The CDN only exposes a "latest" alias whose content can change at any time upstream; previously the downloaded binary ran with no content verification. All three platform artifacts must now match the pinned hash to be installed (the repair path re-verifies existing binaries too); when upstream ships new content the mismatch fails closed and the setup flow degrades to openclaw mode by existing design (no brick). Upgrades require updating the pin table; KIMI_WEBBRIDGE_SKIP_PIN remains a diagnostics escape hatch.
CLI compatibility smoke fixes: cmd.exe argument quoting (whitespace-containing args no longer split; the /s form for wrapper paths with spaces now wraps outer quotes per the cmd contract - machines with spaced usernames no longer fail wholesale); verified 13/13 assertions.

notes.zh:
三路全库代码审查修复批次（主进程 / 前端 / 构建脚本，3 P1 + 10 P2 + 13 P3 共 26 项）：
稳定性：网关启动的预启动步骤（磁盘满/杀软锁文件等）失败不再让状态机永久卡死在「启动中」（此前 start/stop 双双空转，只能重启应用）；「重启网关」的 800ms 防抖窗内退出应用不再可能留下占端口的孤儿网关进程；恢复出厂先停网关再删配置（内核配置监听器不再把配置文件写回复活）；openclaw.json 的 token 补全写入改为原子写
前端：带文件附件发消息期间切换会话不再把消息发进新会话/污染新会话流式状态（会话归属快照前移）；问答卡片的回答提交失败时卡片不再消失（终态只在请求成功后落，内核侧不再空等答案）；断连交错下切换会话不再滞留「加载中」；git 推送无分支时的哨兵值不再渲染成常驻错误横幅；草稿快照加 LRU 上限（防大附件跨会话累积驻留内存）
构建/发版门禁：asar/散文件模式切换后陈旧 gateway.asar 不再被静默打进安装包（此前会发旧内核且全链路绿灯）；缺安装包/latest.yml/blockmap 从「告警假绿」改为硬失败；Node 运行时版本钉定（22.23.2，不再随网络漂移）且 sha256 校验硬失败 + 缓存命中复验；插件矩阵冒烟脚本修复为可用；含括号的仓库路径不再构建失败；CLI 生成脚本改为自定位安装目录（含特殊字符路径不再失败）；合并 release 产物目录先清理防混入旧包
杂项：移除 CSP meta 中被浏览器忽略的 frame-ancestors 指令（消除启动告警）、网关冷启动瞬时连接错误日志降噪、死代码清理、文件选择对话框失焦兜底修复
新增全页面 UI 截图 QA 脚本纳入发版固定流程
notes.en:
Three-track full-repo code review fix batch (main process / frontend / build scripts; 3 P1 + 10 P2 + 13 P3 = 26 items).
Stability: gateway pre-spawn step failures (disk full / AV file locks) no longer deadlock the state machine in "starting" (previously both start and stop became no-ops until app restart); quitting within the 800ms gateway-restart debounce window can no longer leave an orphan gateway process; factory reset now stops the gateway before deleting configs (the kernel config observer can no longer resurrect them); token backfill into openclaw.json is now an atomic write.
Frontend: switching sessions during an attachment-bearing send no longer delivers the message into the new session or corrupts its streaming state (session snapshot moved ahead of the await window); question cards no longer disappear when the resolve request fails (terminal state applies only on success); the loading state no longer sticks when disconnect interleaves with a session switch; the git push no-branch sentinel no longer renders as a persistent error banner; draft snapshots gain an LRU cap (prevents large-attachment memory buildup across sessions).
Build/release gates: a stale gateway.asar from an asar/loose-tree mode switch is no longer silently packaged (previously shipped an old kernel with an all-green pipeline); missing exe/latest.yml/blockmap are now hard failures instead of warn-and-exit-0; the Node runtime version is pinned (22.23.2) with hard sha256 verification plus cache-hit re-verification; the plugin-matrix smoke script is fixed and usable again; repo paths containing parentheses no longer fail the build; the CLI patch script now self-locates the install dir (special-character paths no longer break it); the merged release dir is cleaned before collecting artifacts.
Misc: dropped the ignored-in-meta CSP frame-ancestors directive (startup warning gone), quieter transient gateway connect logs, dead-code cleanup, file-dialog unfocused fallback fix. A full-page UI screenshot QA script joins the fixed release pipeline.

notes.zh:
修复（用户反馈）：设置页「MCP 与钩子」点击「添加服务器」后全页排版重叠——根因是设置页内容列的区块样式在多个平级区块时按 flex basis-0 平分高度，打开表单后内容溢出区块与下方 Webhook 配置视觉叠压；该页现收敛为与其他设置页一致的单区块结构，并加防御样式让任何多区块写法都不再收缩到内容以下（800/834/1024/1440px 宽度全矩阵验证 0 重叠）
应用内更新改为真静默换装：此前「重启以更新」会弹出 NSIS 安装器窗口要求用户点击完成；现在安装器带 /S 全程零 UI，装完自动拉起新版，弹窗类提示均带静默默认值不会隐形阻塞
notes.en:
Fix (user feedback): the settings "MCP & Hooks" page fully overlapped after clicking "Add Server" - the settings content column splits height evenly among sibling sections on a zero flex basis, so the opened form overflowed onto the webhook block below; the page now uses the single-section structure shared by every other settings page, plus a defensive style so any multi-section layout never shrinks below content again (verified 0 overlaps across 800/834/1024/1440px widths).
In-app updates are now truly silent: "Restart to update" previously popped the NSIS installer wizard that required clicks to finish; the installer now runs with /S (zero UI), auto-launches the new version when done, and any message boxes carry silent defaults so nothing can block invisibly.

notes.zh: 消息刷新与内核对齐的及时性优化：①历史滞后补拉退避从 800/1600/2400ms 扩展为 600/1500/3000/6000ms——首档提前 200ms 开始收敛，尾档覆盖内核慢持久化长尾窗口（旧档 2.4s 耗尽后「问了没答」场景无人收敛）；②长任务运行中若 45 秒无流式输出（模型长思考/长工具执行），提前静默对齐一次内核已落盘内容（子代理产出等），不再等 180 秒看门狗
notes.en: Timeliness tuning for chat-history alignment with the kernel: (1) the stale-read retry backoff extends from 800/1600/2400ms to 600/1500/3000/6000ms - the first retry starts 200ms earlier and the last tier now covers slow kernel persistence windows (previously the 2.4s budget could run out with no one converging a pending answer); (2) during a long-running turn with no streaming activity for 45s (long model thinking / tool execution), a silent history alignment now runs early instead of waiting for the 180s watchdog.

notes.zh: 修复（用户反馈）：对话页「回到最新消息」按钮展示错位——按钮此前悬浮在输入框顶缘上（与其重叠约 12px），遮挡输入区上沿；现改为悬浮于消息流内部底缘（最后一条消息上方），与输入框相切不再遮挡，出现/消失不推动输入框位置的特性保持
notes.en: Fix (user feedback): the jump-to-latest button in the chat page was misplaced - it floated over the top edge of the compose input (overlapping ~12px) and covered the upper part of the input area; it now hovers just above the last message inside the message flow, tangent to (never covering) the compose box, while keeping the no-layout-shift appear/disappear behavior.

notes.zh: 对话页新增问答卡片（内核 ask_user 能力适配）：代理需要你决策时（如「要修改哪个文件？」），对话流内直接弹出问题卡——选项按钮一键回答、超时倒计时、跳过自动取消；敏感信息类问题（secret）提交脱敏占位不落明文；多选/复合问题提示在输入框回复。卡片样式与进度卡同一居中列语言，切会话自动过滤、断连重连经 question.list 自动对齐
notes.en: Chat gains question cards (kernel ask_user adaptation): when the agent needs a decision, a question card appears inline in the thread - one-click option buttons, expiry countdown, skip to cancel; secret questions submit a redacted placeholder (never the plaintext); multi-select or compound questions prompt to reply in the composer. Cards share the centered-column visual language of the progress card, are filtered per session, and re-sync via question.list after reconnects.

notes.zh:
设置页新增「MCP 与钩子」tab：可视化管理内核的 MCP 服务器（mcp.servers）——stdio / SSE / streamable-http 三种传输形态的添加、编辑、启停、删除，env/headers 多行编辑，编辑时自动保留超时/OAuth/工具过滤等本界面不涉及的高级字段；同时管理 Webhook 钩子（hooks）——开关、监听路径、访问令牌、默认会话与匹配规则（agent/wake 动作、隔离/持久会话、消息模板），保存即经内核 config.patch 写入 openclaw.json 并按需热应用
全库四路代码审查修复（主进程/前端/构建脚本）：新增服务器重名不再静默覆盖既有配置；删除服务器增加红色确认弹窗；编辑服务器切换传输形态不再残留对侧字段；MCP 服务器删除与 Webhook 钩子保存的若干边界加固
安全加固：主帧加载失败的日志不再泄露 URL 中的 gateway 令牌，诊断包导出对日志内容增加令牌兜底脱敏；kimi-search 插件包下载/缓存启用 sha256 钉定校验；扩展白名单裁剪修复失效路径，内核升级带来的新上游扩展不再静默进包
稳定性：内核升级期间挂起的网关重启不再中途拉起半换装内核（CLI 重启入口同步加互斥）；网关启动重试链不再被单次写盘异常打断；openclaw.json 主写路径改为原子写；渠道验证失败不再永久劫持 Kimi 代理令牌；状态目录被误清后渠道插件不再被启动迁移永久禁用；内核升级器的换装残留自愈修复 path API 误用（此前从未生效）；Windows 含括号安装路径下运行时内核升级不再断裂；设置页渠道保存失败不再卡死按钮；Setup 向导 kimi-code 代理启动失败不再落盘坏配置；发送/切会话后命令补全浮层不再残留；Windows 工作区面包屑显示根目录名而非整条绝对路径；配置写入错误提示按界面语言本地化
notes.en:
Settings gains an MCP & Hooks tab: visually manage the kernel's MCP servers (mcp.servers) - add/edit/enable/delete across stdio, SSE and streamable-http transports, multi-line env/headers editing, and advanced fields (timeouts/OAuth/tool filters) are preserved on edit; webhook hooks (hooks) are manageable too - toggle, listen path, access token, default session and match rules (agent/wake actions, isolated/persistent sessions, message templates). Saving goes through the kernel config.patch into openclaw.json with hot-apply when possible.
Four-track code-review fixes across main process, chat UI and build scripts: adding a duplicate MCP server name no longer silently overwrites existing config; server deletion gains a danger confirm dialog; switching transports on edit no longer leaks fields from the other side; assorted hardening in server delete and hooks save.
Security hardening: gateway tokens no longer leak into logs via failed-load URLs, diagnostics exports sanitize tokens in log contents; the kimi-search plugin download/cache is now sha256-pinned; the extension allowlist prune was re-pointed at the live path so new upstream extensions from kernel upgrades no longer ship silently.
Stability: a pending gateway restart during a kernel update can no longer spawn a half-swapped kernel (the CLI restart entry gains the same mutex); the gateway start retry chain survives single write failures; the main openclaw.json write path is now atomic; a failed channel credential verify no longer hijacks the Kimi proxy token; channel plugins survive a wiped state dir instead of being permanently disabled by startup migration; the kernel updater's swap-debris self-heal had its path-API misuse fixed (it never ran before); runtime kernel updates no longer break under Windows install paths containing parentheses; channel settings save failures no longer wedge the save button; the setup wizard no longer writes a broken provider when the kimi-code proxy fails to start; the slash-command suggest popup no longer lingers after send/session switch; the Windows workspace breadcrumb shows the root folder name instead of the full absolute path; config write errors are localized to the UI language.

notes.zh:
修复（用户反馈）：切换会话或刷新对话窗口后，正在执行的任务消息输出不再恢复——本地 run 状态在这些路径被清空后，内核仍在跑的 run 的增量帧被当作其他客户端的广播丢弃；现在利用内核 chat.history 响应附带的在途 run 快照（runId + 全量累计文本）重建流式状态，切回会话/刷新/断连重连后流式输出与停止按钮自动恢复续显
修复（连带发现）：窗口刷新（Ctrl+R）会命中界面改写出的虚拟地址（/chat 等）导致整页空白——主帧加载失败时自动回退真实入口页重载，并保留当前会话参数
notes.en:
Fix (user feedback): after switching sessions or refreshing the chat window, an in-progress task's message output never resumed - once local run state was cleared on those paths, deltas from the still-running kernel run were dropped as another client's broadcast; the chat.history response now carries an in-flight run snapshot (runId + full accumulated text) that rebuilds the streaming state, so output and the Stop button resume automatically after switching back, refreshing, or reconnecting.
Fix (found along the way): refreshing the window (Ctrl+R) hit the UI's rewritten virtual address (/chat) and produced a blank page - main-frame load failures now fall back to the real entry page with the current session preserved.

notes.zh: 修复（用户反馈）：子代理等待状态卡此前没有与历史消息列对齐——卡片容器无宽度约束会撑满整个对话线程，视觉上远宽于上下的消息；现与消息组/进度卡共用同一 760px 居中阅读列，卡片本体同步去掉了 520px 限宽、补齐描边投影与工具卡一致的视觉节奏
notes.en: Fix (user feedback): subagent waiting cards were not aligned with the message column - the card container had no width constraint and stretched across the whole chat thread; it now shares the same 760px centered reading column as message groups and the progress card, and the card itself drops the 520px cap with matched border/shadow rhythm.

notes.zh:
修复（用户反馈）：三家提供商的「查询用量 / 余额」与「同步模型」入口此前是 13px 纯图标按钮几乎不可发现，现改为 provider 块头的带文字胶囊按钮（同步模型 / 查用量），一眼可见
修复（用户反馈）：Kimi 会员额度卡片消失——OAuth refresh token 被服务端作废（invalid_grant 走 400）时旧逻辑不清理本地 token，界面恒显「登录成功」但用量接口 401 静默失败；现自动清理失效会话并引导重新登录，登录有效但用量拉取失败时显示可重试的提示行（本次失效因登录已过期数日，重新登录后额度即恢复）
对话页（用户反馈）：Progress Card 进度卡宽度收窄并与输入框对齐（同 760px 居中列，此前会撑满整行）；输入框位置下移、与窗口底部间距收紧（底部留白 30px→14px）
模型设置排版：自定义分组管理区默认折叠为一行标题+分组数徽标，不再把模型列表推到首屏之外；展开即可管理
notes.en:
Fix (user feedback): the usage/balance query and model-sync actions were 13px icon-only buttons that were practically invisible; they are now labeled pill buttons (Sync models / Usage) in the provider block header.
Fix (user feedback): Kimi membership usage cards disappeared - when the OAuth refresh token was revoked server-side (invalid_grant arrives as HTTP 400), the old logic never cleared the local token, so the UI kept showing Logged in while the usage API silently failed with 401; now the stale session is auto-cleared with a re-login prompt, and a retryable hint row appears when usage cannot be fetched while logged in (this outage was an expired login - re-login restores the cards).
Chat (user feedback): Progress Card narrowed and aligned with the compose input (same 760px centered column, previously full-width); input box moved lower with reduced bottom gap (30px to 14px).
Provider settings layout: the custom-groups manager now collapses to a single title row with a count badge, keeping the model list above the fold.

notes.zh:
模型设置（R52）：新增「从提供商获取模型列表」——提供商块头一键拉取线上 /models 实时清单（OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Moonshot/智谱/火山/通义/DeepSeek/MiniMax/自定义端点全适配，Kimi 走本地代理），在线同步面板勾选即可批量添加新模型；添加模型面板新增「从提供商获取」按钮（目录+在线合并去重）
用量/余额查询：DeepSeek（官方 /user/balance）、Moonshot（官方 /users/me/balance）、智谱 GLM Coding Plan（配额百分比+重置倒计时）一键查询，余额/配额卡片就地渲染；其余提供商提示暂不支持
Git 面板增强：分支列表与一键切换、最近 30 条提交历史（首屏即加载）、推送/拉取（未设 upstream 自动设 origin；禁用交互凭据防卡死）、丢弃未暂存改动、删除未跟踪文件（均二次危险确认）
Worktrees：新增手动「新建 Worktree」（名称 + 基线分支下拉，内核 worktrees.create/branches RPC，可与 Git 面板联动）
删除守卫：会话或其 worktree 有进行中（queued/running）任务时，侧边栏删除项禁用 + 删除链路拦截，防止误删运行中的任务
任务列表排版优化：时间并入 meta 行、进行中任务左侧 accent 强调条、操作列右对齐垂直居中、密度收紧
安全加固：git 文件路径参数拒绝 pathspec magic（如 :(glob)** 可绕过路径校验清空全仓库未跟踪文件）
死代码清理：56 个零引用 i18n 键、17 个无消费方导出（含 40 行从未接线的浏览器扩展卸载逻辑）
修复：Git 面板嵌入模式（工作区页）此前不渲染推送/拉取按钮；内核目录缺失时 dev 冒烟环境网关无法启动的问题已记录于 gotchas
notes.en:
Model settings (R52): one-click live model list fetch from provider /models endpoints (OpenAI/Anthropic/Google/Moonshot/Zhipu/Volcengine/Qwen/DeepSeek/MiniMax/custom, Kimi via local proxy); pick and batch-add new models from the sync panel; the add-model form gains a Fetch-from-provider button (catalog + live merged, deduped).
Usage & balance queries: DeepSeek (official /user/balance), Moonshot (official /users/me/balance), Zhipu GLM Coding Plan (quota percentage + reset countdown); balance/quota cards render inline; other providers report unsupported for now.
Git panel: branch list with one-click switch, recent 30 commits history (loaded on first paint), push/pull (auto set-upstream to origin; interactive credential prompts disabled to avoid hangs), discard unstaged changes, remove untracked files (all behind danger confirms).
Worktrees: manual New Worktree (name + base branch picker, backed by kernel worktrees.create/branches RPC) with Git panel integration.
Delete guards: sessions and their worktrees with running (queued/running) tasks cannot be deleted - sidebar item disabled and the delete path blocks with a toast.
Task list polish: timestamp merged into the meta line, accent bar for active tasks, right-aligned action column, tighter density.
Security: git path arguments now reject pathspec magic (e.g. :(glob)** could bypass path validation and wipe all untracked files).
Dead code cleanup: 56 unreferenced i18n keys and 17 unconsumed exports (incl. 40 lines of never-wired browser extension uninstall logic).
Fixes: push/pull buttons were unreachable in the embedded (workspace) Git panel; gateway-cannot-start dev smoke scenario documented in gotchas.

notes.zh:
修复（重大）：静默更新与同版重装稳定失败——旧卸载器在更新模式下逐项搬移文件报错退出，新安装器重试后弹窗卡死更新链路；现由自定义宏接管文件移除与失败兜底，更新全程无弹窗完成
安装器界面重构：品牌欢迎/完成页标题带版本号，卸载向导补上品牌侧图与标题，底部品牌文字替换 Nullsoft 默认字样，完成页新增更新日志链接
安装器语言精简为 中文+英文 双语（其他系统语言自动回退英文），卸载时的清理选项（删除 CLI / WebBridge 缓存 / 用户数据）随系统语言正确显示中英文
安装提速：全新安装不再白等 2 秒杀进程等待（仅在确实杀掉了进程时才等待句柄释放）
修复：更新弹窗此前从不显示新版本说明（本地内置的更新日志不可能包含未安装版本），现在自动从 GitHub Release 拉取对应版本说明
修复：打包产物缺少 node 代理导致无系统 Node 的机器上内核自动升级必然失败
安全加固：主窗口拦截一切目录外导航与新窗口打开；WebBridge 下载拒绝 https→http 降级重定向；内核版本号与技能目录名参数注入校验；svg 不再允许 shell 直接打开（浏览器 file:// 打开 svg 可执行内嵌脚本）；端口占用者强杀前校验进程镜像名防误杀无关服务
性能：.openclaw 数据包导出的目录遍历与临时目录清理改为异步（不再冻结主进程数秒）；渲染热路径去掉逐帧 localStorage 读取；修复思考档位/回放点弹层反复开关累积泄漏的监听器
内核升级器健壮性：升级锁改独占创建（防并发升级交错换装）、状态文件原子写入、崩溃残留自动进位/还原/清理
notes.en:
Fix (major): silent updates and same-version reinstalls reliably failed - the old uninstaller aborted while moving files aside in update mode, leaving the new installer stuck on a dialog after retries; custom NSIS macros now take over file removal and failure recovery so updates complete without any dialog
Installer UI refresh: branded welcome/finish titles with version number, the uninstall wizard now gets the branded sidebar and title, the bottom branding text replaces the default Nullsoft string, and the finish page links to release notes
Installer languages trimmed to Chinese + English (other locales fall back to English); uninstall cleanup options (CLI / WebBridge cache / user data) now localize correctly
Faster installs: fresh installs no longer wait a fixed 2s process-kill delay (the wait only happens when processes were actually killed)
Fix: the update dialog never showed notes for the new version (the bundled changelog cannot contain not-yet-installed versions); it now fetches the matching GitHub release notes automatically
Fix: packaged builds lacked a node shim, which made kernel auto-updates always fail on machines without a system Node.js
Security hardening: the main window now blocks all out-of-tree navigation and window.open; WebBridge downloads reject https-to-http redirect downgrades; kernel tag and skill-directory argument-injection validation; svg removed from shell-open allowlist (svg in a browser file:// origin can execute embedded scripts); port-holder force-kill now verifies the process image name first
Performance: .openclaw export tree walk and temp cleanup are now async (no more multi-second main-process freezes); hot render path no longer reads localStorage every frame; fixed listener leaks accumulating on the thinking-level and rewind popovers
Kernel updater robustness: exclusive lock creation (no interleaved concurrent swaps), atomic state-file writes, and automatic roll-forward/restore/cleanup of crash leftovers

notes.zh:
内核升级：openclaw 2026.8.2 → 2026.9.2。修复 asar 形态硬阻断——2026.9.2 把边界校验函数迁入独立 @openclaw/fs-safe 包导致旧补丁全部漏打；补丁扫描现已覆盖 fs-safe 包（root-file/pinned-open/regular-file/file-identity 四处 asar 快速通道），身份观测映射只作用于 lstat 且返回路径保持 asar 虚拟路径（模块解析不再脱离归档），并新增形态感知覆盖断言与产物级断言防止再次静默漏打
安装体积：gateway.asar 减约 10MB——移除 tree-sitter C 源码（prebuilds/wasm 保留）；asar.unpacked 移除非目标平台 fs-safe native 目录；修复打包器不清理上一次构建 .unpacked 残留的问题（陈旧文件曾随安装器分发）
修复：设置页「导出」.openclaw 数据包恒失败——状态目录内的符号链接/junction（内核 peer 链接、plugin-skills 缓存等，实测 26 个）现按机器相关运行时产物跳过而不是让整包导出失败
界面：历史更新日志最多显示 15 条，弹窗不再随版本累积无限变长
notes.en:
Kernel upgrade: openclaw 2026.8.2 -> 2026.9.2. Fixes the hard asar blocker - 2026.9.2 moved the boundary-verification functions into the standalone @openclaw/fs-safe package so every legacy patch silently missed; patch scanning now covers the fs-safe package (asar fast paths in root-file, pinned-open, regular-file, and file-identity), the identity-observation mapping only wraps the lstat probes while returned paths stay asar-virtual (module resolution no longer escapes the archive), plus shape-aware coverage assertions and artifact-level assertions to prevent another silent miss
Install size: gateway.asar shrinks by ~10MB - tree-sitter C sources removed (prebuilds/wasm kept); non-target-platform fs-safe native dirs dropped from asar.unpacked; fixed the packer not clearing the previous build's .unpacked residue (stale files used to ship with the installer)
Fix: exporting the .openclaw data bundle from Settings always failed - symlinks/junctions inside the state dir (kernel peer links, plugin-skills caches; 26 in the wild) are now skipped as machine-specific runtime artifacts instead of failing the whole export
UI: the changelog dialog now shows at most 15 entries so it no longer grows unbounded with versions

notes.zh:
会话导出：聊天页标题栏新增导出按钮——优先内核 transcripts.get（2026.9.2 能力），8.2 内核自动回退本地历史序列化；同时复制到剪贴板并下载 Markdown 文件
插件矩阵：新增可自动化插件矩阵冒烟（69 扩展 manifest/版本/入口枚举 + 隔离启动抓取实际加载清单）
内核取证：完成 2026.8.2→2026.9.2 全面对比（RPC +40/-0、chat delta 逐字节一致、扩展布局不变、Node engine 门槛、CLI 命令树差异）
升级闸门：实测发现 2026.9.2 asar 形态硬阻断——渠道插件公开构件的 fs-safe 身份校验与 asar 虚拟文件系统不兼容（内核自带 telegram 同样失败），内核继续 pin 2026.8.2，修复方向已记录
notes.en:
Transcript export: new export button in the chat titlebar - prefers the kernel transcripts.get (a 2026.9.2 capability) with automatic fallback to local history serialization on 8.2; copies to clipboard and downloads a Markdown file
Plugin matrix: added an automatable plugin-matrix smoke (enumerates 69 extensions for manifest/version/entry and captures the actually-loaded plugin list from an isolated boot)
Kernel recon: completed the 2026.8.2 vs 2026.9.2 diff (RPC +40/-0, byte-identical chat delta, unchanged extension layout, Node engine gate, CLI tree drift)
Upgrade gate: live testing found a hard 2026.9.2 asar blocker - the fs-safe identity verification for channel plugin public surfaces is incompatible with the asar virtual filesystem (the kernel-shipped telegram channel fails identically); the kernel stays pinned at 2026.8.2 and remediation directions are documented

notes.zh:
CLI：新增命令行全兼容冒烟脚本——70 个顶层命令矩阵自动生成、全部子命令 --help 通过、透传/退出码/stdout-stderr 分离/全局参前后/特殊字符与中文 cwd 逐项验证 13/13 通过
CLI：实测命令矩阵差异（2026.9.2 新增 wiki，移除 browser/file-transfer/googlemeet/teamsmeetings/zoommeetings），为内核升级闸门提供情报
CLI：gateway 依赖语义验证——cron 类命令未启动时报错清晰，sessions 列表支持本地 sqlite 离线直读，--version 完全离线
界面：重连后命令目录改为强制刷新，内核升级换装后不再返回旧命令缓存
说明：Ctrl+C 转发经控制台广播架构生效；wrapper 单测 13 项与 openclaw/openclaw-cn 共存检测保持全绿
notes.en:
CLI: added a full-compatibility smoke script - auto-generated matrix of 70 top-level commands, every subcommand --help passing, and 13/13 checks for passthrough, exit codes, stdout/stderr separation, global-flag ordering, special characters, and CJK working directories
CLI: measured command-matrix drift against 2026.9.2 (adds wiki; removes browser, file-transfer, googlemeet, teamsmeetings, zoommeetings) as input for the kernel-upgrade gate
CLI: verified gateway-dependency semantics - gateway-backed commands fail with clear errors while offline, sessions list reads the local sqlite store, and --version is fully offline
UI: the slash-command catalog is force-refreshed on reconnect so a swapped kernel no longer serves stale commands
Notes: Ctrl+C forwarding works via console broadcast; 13 wrapper unit tests and openclaw/openclaw-cn coexistence detection stay green

notes.zh:
流式：修复 provider 降级重生成时 replace 全文帧未剥离工具冻结前缀导致的文本重复；新增 2000 帧混合增量压力回归
诊断：布局诊断新增弹窗层级不变量（对话框不得低于标题栏）与纯函数单测
冒烟：CDP 布局冒烟升级为多场景引擎——视图巡览（6 个 rail 视图）× 断点宽度 × 深浅主题 × DPI 100/125/150% × prefers-reduced-motion × 中英文重载，22 个场景结构化报告
修复语言场景导航到 SPA 虚拟路径导致错误页的问题（还原真实 index.html 入口）
notes.en:
Streaming: replace frames carrying the full text after a provider-fallback regeneration now strip the frozen tool prefix, fixing duplicated pre-tool text; added a 2000-frame mixed-delta stress regression
Diagnostics: layout diagnostics gained a dialog-layering invariant (dialogs must layer at or above the titlebar) with pure-function unit tests
Smoke: the CDP layout smoke is now a multi-scenario engine — view tour (6 rail views) x breakpoint widths x light/dark themes x DPI 100/125/150% x prefers-reduced-motion x zh/en reloads, 22 structured scenario reports
Fixed the language scenario navigating to the SPA virtual path and landing on an error page (restore the real index.html entry)

notes.zh:
流式：正式消费内核协议 deltaText / replace 增量，旧版全文快照保留为兼容回退；终态前强制提交挂起的渲染文本，error 终态不再丢失已显示的部分回答
恢复：断线 orphan run 快照改为按会话隔离，切换会话后外来 run 的帧不再被误收养
诊断：新增布局诊断能力（横向溢出、视口溢出、可交互元素遮挡结构化报告），供 CDP 冒烟与后续排版回归使用
工程：修复 asar 冒烟测试在内核彩色输出下 ready 匹配失败的既有缺陷，scripts 测试恢复全绿
notes.en:
Streaming: natively consume the kernel protocol deltaText / replace frames while keeping full-text snapshots as a legacy fallback; pending rendered text is committed before terminal states, so partial answers are no longer lost on errors
Recovery: reconnect orphan-run snapshots are now scoped per session, so frames from a foreign run can no longer be adopted after a session switch
Diagnostics: added structured layout diagnostics (horizontal overflow, viewport overflow, interactive-element occlusion) exposed for CDP smoke tests and future layout regressions
Engineering: fixed the asar smoke test to match the ready line under the kernel colorized output, restoring a fully green scripts suite

notes.zh:
内核适配：对齐 openclaw 2026.8.2 Progress Card 协议；新进度卡优先替代旧 update_plan 面板，同时为旧内核与历史会话保留回退显示
对话：完善流式工具输入与终态结果卡片，错误摘要、退出码、diff 统计、复制输出和代码语言识别更清晰
体验：Progress Card 支持步骤状态、当前进度、折叠记忆、会话切换与重连刷新；并加固并发刷新、清除乐观锁与失败提示
工程：补齐 Progress Card 与工具结果展示回归测试，并移除本轮 CSS 注释和动态导入构建告警
notes.en:
Kernel adaptation: aligned with the openclaw 2026.8.2 Progress Card protocol. The new card takes priority over the legacy update_plan panel, while older kernels and historical sessions retain a fallback
Chat: improved streamed tool input and terminal result cards with clearer error summaries, exit codes, diff statistics, copy output, and code-language detection
Experience: Progress Card now supports step state, current progress, persisted collapse, session-switch and reconnect refresh, plus hardened refresh concurrency, optimistic dismissal, and failure feedback
Engineering: added Progress Card and tool-result regression coverage and removed this round's CSS-comment and dynamic-import build warnings

notes.zh:
界面：技能商店与技能页的头像色板收敛为 CryoBlue 蓝青同族色系，告别杂色，与应用整体设计语言一致
界面：会话面板分隔条加宽命中区并常驻可见细线，悬停/拖拽时显示加粗辉光指示条，调整布局更好找、更跟手
界面：全屏空状态页标题统一提升到展示字号阶梯（任务管理等页面），视觉层级更清晰
工程：修复网关冒烟测试在注入了 OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH 等环境变量的宿主机上误报失败（子进程环境隔离加固）
notes.en:
UI: skill store and skills page avatar palette narrowed to the CryoBlue blue-cyan family — no more mixed hues, consistent with the app's design language
UI: session panel splitter gains a wider hit area and an always-visible hairline, with a thicker glowing indicator on hover/drag — easier to find and grab
UI: full-screen empty-state titles (task management and similar pages) unified into the display type scale for clearer visual hierarchy
Engineering: fixed the gateway asar smoke test falsely failing on hosts that inject OPENCLAW_CONFIG_PATH and similar environment variables (child-process environment isolation hardened)

notes.zh:
修复：Kimi 模型静默落入备用链——内置回环鉴权代理在本机环回地址上要求握手密钥，kimi-code 侧不携带该密钥时主模型 401 后静默切换 fallback；现已移除该代理特性，Kimi 通道直连
品牌焕新：全新 CryoBlue 蓝青混色设计体系——为高效工作服务的沉稳蓝（活力而不抢眼），浅色一等 + 暗色独立调参双主题，应用图标、托盘图标、安装器界面同步换新
图标体系：全部界面图标换为自绘 CryoIcons（24 网格、2px 描边、纯几何造型），移除第三方图标库依赖，包体更小
官网重设计：浅色一等 + CryoBlue 混色，与应用同一套设计语言
notes.en:
Fixed: Kimi models silently falling back — the built-in loopback auth proxy required a handshake secret on the loopback address, and when the kimi-code side did not carry it the primary model silently switched to fallback after a 401; the proxy feature has been removed and the Kimi channel now connects directly
Brand refresh: the new CryoBlue blue-cyan blended design system — a steady work-oriented blue that stays lively without being loud, light-first plus an independently tuned dark theme, with app icons, tray icons and the installer UI refreshed to match
Icon system: all UI icons replaced by the self-drawn CryoIcons set (24px grid, 2px stroke, pure geometry), dropping the third-party icon library for a smaller bundle
Website redesigned: light-first with the CryoBlue blend, sharing the app's design language

notes.zh:
安装器界面焕新：安装/卸载向导换装应用同款品牌视觉（indigo 渐变侧图 + 页头横幅）
新手引导新增「快速通道」：检测到本机已有的 API key 环境变量（OpenAI / Anthropic / Moonshot / Google / DeepSeek）可一键采用，自动真实验证并写入配置；密钥明文不离开主进程，界面仅显示掩码
内核版本兜底自动升级：内核低于最低支持版本（2026.7.0）时启动后自动升级到策展稳定版 2026.8.2，右上角横幅实时显示进度，失败自动回滚
迁移与可恢复性加固：内核自动回滚同步反向迁移配置；导入 .openclaw 归档前自动创建应急备份、失败自动还原；老版本迁移不再丢失更新渠道等既有设置；内核备份附带配置快照
全新安装默认内核 2026.8.2；应用更新继续使用差异更新（只下载变化部分）
notes.en:
Installer UI refresh: the install/uninstall wizard now carries the app's brand identity (indigo-gradient sidebar + header banner)
New setup fast lane: existing provider API keys found in environment variables (OpenAI / Anthropic / Moonshot / Google / DeepSeek) can be adopted with one click — verified against the real API and written to config; plaintext keys never leave the main process and the UI shows only masked values
Automatic kernel floor upgrade: when the kernel is below the minimum supported version (2026.7.0), it auto-upgrades to the curated stable 2026.8.2 after startup with live progress in a banner; failures roll back automatically
Migration & recoverability hardening: automatic kernel rollback now reverse-migrates config; importing a .openclaw archive creates an emergency backup first with auto-restore on failure; legacy migrations no longer drop existing settings like update channel; kernel backups now include a config snapshot
Fresh installs ship kernel 2026.8.2 by default; app updates continue to use differential downloads (only changed blocks are fetched)

notes.zh:
新功能：更新提示弹窗——启动时自动检查到新版本会弹出更新日志，由你决定何时更新（不再静默后台下载，点击「更新」才开始下载，弹窗内显示下载进度）
新功能：暂缓更新——可选 7 天 / 1 个月 / 3 个月 / 永久 / 自定义天数，期内不再自动检查更新；设置-关于页可随时恢复
优化：安装更新改为带进度条的安装器窗口，换装进度可见（此前为无界面的静默安装）
界面：设置-关于页适配新流程（「更新」按钮手动触发下载、显示暂缓状态与恢复入口）
notes.en:
New: update prompt dialog — when a new version is found at startup, a dialog shows the release notes and lets you decide when to update (no more silent background downloads; downloading starts only after you click "Update", with in-dialog progress)
New: snooze update prompts — 7 days / 1 month / 3 months / forever / custom days; no automatic checks while snoozed, resume anytime from Settings → About
Improved: installing an update now shows an installer window with a progress bar instead of a silent install
UI: Settings → About adapted to the new flow (manual "Update" button to start the download, snooze status with a resume entry)

notes.zh:
修复：内核更新误提示非稳定版——openclaw 官方 npm 的 latest 标签会指向发行证据链未完成的版本（如 2026.9.1），此前直接用它当更新目标；现改为 CryoClaw 策展稳定版渠道：远程 kernel-channel.json（国内镜像备选，离线时回退到随应用发行的内置版本），只有经策展确认的稳定版才会提示更新
优化：手动装过更高内核版本（--tag 指定）的用户不再被提示「更新」到更低版本，无指定版本的升级也不会暗降级
界面：内核升级面板「最新版本」更名为「稳定版本」
notes.en:
Fixed: kernel update prompts for non-stable releases — openclaw's npm latest tag can point to versions with an incomplete release chain (e.g. 2026.9.1) and was used directly as the update target; now using a CryoClaw-curated stable channel: remote kernel-channel.json (with a CN mirror fallback, and a built-in version shipped with the app when offline), only curated stable versions trigger update prompts
Improved: users who manually installed a newer kernel (via --tag) are no longer prompted to "update" to an older version, and untargeted upgrades no longer silently downgrade
UI: kernel panel "Latest Version" renamed to "Stable Version"

notes.zh:
修复：打包安装后 Gateway 无法启动——asar 包内内核边界补丁（openRootFile）返回了未定义的路径参数，内核 2026.8.2 的启动加载链直接崩溃；该问题自 v2026.811.8 起存在，因开发验证一直走松散文件模式而未暴露。已修复并新增 asar 打包形态冒烟测试防回归
修复：安装过不完整扩展（如纯技能插件，目录存在但无可运行程序）时 Gateway 反复报「迁移未收敛」永不就绪——启动时自动将不可用插件降级为禁用（配置完整保留，可随时在扩展商店重装恢复）
受影响用户说明：若你装过 holo-wechat-mp 扩展，本次更新后它会被自动禁用，在扩展商店重新安装即可恢复
notes.en:
Fixed: Gateway failing to start after packaged installation — the kernel boundary patch (openRootFile) inside the asar bundle returned an undefined path parameter, crashing the 2026.8.2 kernel's startup chain; present since v2026.811.8 but never caught because dev verification always ran in loose-file mode. Fixed, with new asar-form smoke tests to prevent regression
Fixed: Gateway never becoming ready ("migration not converged" loop) when an incompletely installed extension (e.g. a skill-only plugin with no runnable payload) is present — unavailable plugins are now auto-disabled at startup with their config preserved; reinstall from the extension store anytime to restore
Note for affected users: if you installed the holo-wechat-mp extension, it will be auto-disabled by this update; reinstall it from the extension store to restore

notes.zh:
修复：QQ 渠道在 2026.8.2 内核下反复崩溃——官方 qqbot 插件的 import "ws" 命中 ws 包的 ESM 包装（wrapper.mjs），在新内核插件加载链下互操作失败（permessage-deflate ... no export named 'default'），渠道每 5 分钟崩溃重启；现构建期对 qqbot 强制单文件重打包（ws 静态内联），实测 QQ 网关连接稳定
修复：企微/微信插件加载失败（Dynamic require of "crypto"）——esbuild ESM 产物注入 createRequire/__dirname 兼容 banner；插件包入口补丁同步改写 runtimeExtensions，bundle 新增内容标记使旧产物自动重建

notes.en:
New era: renamed to CryoClaw with an all-new ice-blue visual design (light/dark themes)
New: rebuilt model management — provider grouping, real API-key validation, fallback model configuration
New: terminal session list and usage now update via realtime events
Improved: streaming replies render per-frame as plain text — long answers no longer degrade; full formatting applied once when the reply finishes
Improved: collapsed tool-call sections render lazily on first expand — long sessions scroll and switch noticeably faster
Improved: storage trimming — removed off-platform native deps, redundant plugin type declarations and frontend sourcemaps, significantly smaller app size
Improved: official plugin updates (Feishu/QQ Bot etc.); kimi-claw plugin removed, replaced by built-in features

notes.en:
Fix: skill proposal approvals (Apply workspace skill proposal) now appear above the composer with approve/deny (previously only logged in Settings, always expiring after 70s)
Fix: plan floating panel moved down, no longer overlapping window min/max/close buttons
Fix: tool-output sidebar header and top error banner no longer hidden under the title bar; tasks view top padding aligned
Security: installer no longer bundles .env.build, .cache debug data or duplicated resources (installer size halved, back to ~134MB)
Improve: sidebar session menu flips upward near the bottom; approval panel is height-capped and scrollable; top toasts clear the title bar and are width-capped

notes.zh:
新功能：任务进行时发送的消息进入队列，队列消息现在可编辑、可删除、可点「立即发送」插队

notes.en:
New: messages sent during a run are queued — queue items can now be edited, deleted, or sent immediately
New: a notice appears when the model falls back to a backup model, and when it recovers
Improved: Stop and Send buttons now coexist during a run (send = enqueue); clearer queue hint
Security: API keys are masked in settings; unchanged keys are never re-sent; config API no longer returns plaintext keys
Improved: run failures show only the inline warning card (no more duplicate banner + card)
Improved: all native confirm dialogs replaced with the app's own style (danger actions get a red confirm)

notes.zh:

notes.en:
